notes.title: Patch Notes 1.7.1.1 - PlayStation crossplay
notes.content:
Hello Bounty Hunters!

We're deploying a small patch today that will improve and fix some issues, but most importantly it'll enable crossplay between PC and PlayStation when the game is released on [b]PS4 and PS5 this Thursday, July 20th[/b].
[list]
[*] Addressed some graphical issues that diminished the experience.
[*] Improved the texture streaming that forced low resolution textures during longplay sessions.
[*] Fixed some rendering issues with items in the rewards screens.
[*] Fixed an audio memory corruption issue which could crash the game.
[*] Crossplay between PC and PlayStation is now available. Please note that for PlayStation players, a PlayStation Plus subscription is required for online co-op.
[/list]
Also, to celebrate the arrival of Killsquad to PlayStation, we've activated our biggest discount yet, and you can now get Killsquad at [b]65% off until Sunday[/b]! Tell your friends and go together for some mayhem hunting!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/910490/Killsquad/

See you in space, Bounty Hunters!

notes.title: Killsquad Hotfix
notes.content:
[h1]Killsquad mini update, version 1.6.4.11[/h1]

Hello Bounty Hunters!

Since the big optimization update called “Under the Hood” many bugs have emerged because of the big changes made. We have launched two hotfixes solving major bugs and crashes. Now, we are releasing another little update fixing more issues/problems that were present on the build and you, our appreciated community, have reported. 

The list of [b]bugs fixed[/b] is the following:
[list]
[*]The leaderboard of [i]Infinite Colosseum[/i] would not save and update the score properly.
[*]Cass’ shuriken skill had the possibility of getting in infinite cooldown sometimes.
[*]The terminal area of the contract “[i]SHUT IT DOWN[/i]” wasn’t appearing.
[*]When a player, playing as a client, would return to the lobby while in a contract it get blocked with a black screen 
[*]A player would get stuck in a colosseum if another one got out of the contract in the round exchange.
[*]UI icons in the contract map menu would make a weird shake when the player was moving the map or making zoom.
[*]Fixed a block in “[i]FOR THE UPRISING[/i]” contract that would occur sometimes with the Scrappy.
[/list]

If you are still experiencing crashes you can contact us directly at [b]killsquad@novarama.com[/b], and send us your "[u]Saved" folder[/u]. (you can find it in   [u]C:\Users%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Killsquad[/u]). For other issues, your reports via the bug-report channel on discord & Steam discussion are very helpful.

See you in space, Bounty Hunters!

notes.title: New Hotfix Released
notes.content:
Hello Bounty Hunters!

After the last hotfix, there were some critical bugs that still remained in the game. Thanks to your help with reporting these issues, and the work of our dev team, we are now able to release a new patch that will get rid of these bugs. We hope that now you can finally play without issues and we apologise for any inconvenience the last patch caused.


List of bugs fixed:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the deactivation of “[i]The Runaway[/i]” traps after defeating him, making it possible to be killed after successfully finalizing the contract.
[*]Fixed a bug with the [i]game trackers[/i] that disabled unlocking the game’s achievements 
[*]Fixed a graphical UI bug that rendered the lobby invitation buttons unavailable.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the proper unlocking of the [i]inferno contracts[/i], the [i]infinite[/i], & [i]elemental colosseums[/i].
[*]We have also fixed six specific crashes that some of you reported & helped identify.
[/list]


If you are still experiencing crashes you can contact us directly at  [b]killsquad@novarama.com[/b], and send us your "[u]Saved[/u]" folder. (you can find it in   [u]C:\Users%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Killsquad[/u]). For other issues, your reports via the bug-report channel on discord & Steam discussion are very helpful.

Hope that this patch makes your experience with Killsquad is better & smoother than ever.

See you in space, Bounty Hunters!


By the way, you can still sign up for our Insider Program here: https://novarama.com/novarama-insider-program/

notes.title: Killsquad “Under the Hood” Update is Here!
notes.content:
[h1]Killsquad Update 1.6.1.4  [/h1]

Welcome Bounty Hunters,

First of all, we want to say huge thanks to all of you who have taken the time to report to us all the bugs, issues, and problems that you encountered. All of your feedback was the foundation of the update that’s now in your download queue. 

This new update is all about making Killsquad a much better experience. As we’re gearing up for the PS4 release of Killsquad (cross-play incoming!) we’ve made changes in the game’s core engine code and we gave Killsquad a performance upgrade too. We also added a new online system based on *EOS* so that we can improve online service and make the game well-prepared to crossplay with the incoming PS4 version. 

To make your whole experience with Killsquad better, we’ve changed a lot of the game’s code. We had to make sure that this version is stable and it’s compatible with the PS4 device. To achieve that we had to re-work the [i]particle/VFX system[/i] in CPU costs, tweak the [i]animation system[/i], the [i]simulation of movement[/i], and also the [i]network processing[/i]. During all these changes a lot of bugs and problems occurred which we had to fix too. So this whole process took us quite a bit of time. But all of that work was definitely worth it, because as a result, we now have a much more optimized game! 

Also, we’ve fixed the occasional crashes that some of you reported to us. Thanks to your help,Killsquad is more steady than ever.

[u]Most important crashes fixed:[/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash that occur opening reward chests
[*]Fixed a crash that was provoked by Cass’ shuriken skill.
[*]Fixed random crashes during contracts.
[*]Fixed a crash that occurs during the Splash Screen
[/list]

And finally, we have made fixes of other [u]minor bugs[/u] (not crashing issues) that the Community have reported and many more that came up during the development of new systems and improvements.

[u]Minor bugs fixed:[/u]
[list]
[*]Various localization bugs fixed on several items/cosmetics
[*]Fixed performance issues with Meteors that spawn on some contracts
[*]Fixed some rendering bugs related to the UI, lighting and also some contracts, that sometimes were shown too lighted
[*]Fixed a bug where 2 assets of lamps were blocking the view of the game camera in some situations in the M.A.G.N.U.S battle.
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes the healing done in a contract was negative.
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes Gadgets were not shown on the UI playing a contract as a client
[*]Fixed a bug where the traps located at “Trouble in paradise” contract, were not working properly playing as a client.
[*]Fixed a bug where Numpad keys were not bindable in the game inputs.
[*]Fixed a bug where some mobs spawned by Queen Mogoth got stuck under the ground.
[*]Fixed a bug where Zero would keep the attack beam on while dead.
[*]Fixed a bug where the traps of [i]Hunted Hunter[/i] contract were working incorrectly.
[*]Fixed a bug where the [i]Jotuns[/i] enemies on the contract [i]Crazy about Jade[/i] were not eliminated at the end of the mission and were stopping if the player placed in front of them
[*]Fixed a minor bug where faction emote visuals were incorrectly distorted in the 3D preview
[*]Fixed a minor bug where a light flash would appear on the screen every time you click on a gadget in the menus.
[*]Fixed a bug where the tail of Queen Moggoth had physics and movement after it was cut. 
[*]Fixed a bug where Trouble in Paradise lasers were working weirdly playing as a client
[*]Fixed a bug where the “ready light” in the lobby was rendering badly.
[/list]

[b]What’s next & what are we doing right now:[/b]
[list]
[*]Finishing the PS4 port.
[*]Polishing and bug fixing.
[/list]

If your game crashes, a Crash reporter will appear, add the details of what you were doing at the time of the crash and send it to us. If you want to, you can also contact us directly at killsquad@novarama.com, and send us your "Saved" folder. (you can find it in   C:\Users\%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Killsquad). This will be very helpful.

For those of you that might not know, part of our studio is working on a new project. We haven’t revealed what it is yet, but we would love to show you the game first, before everyone else. We are looking for testers from both the US and EU regions. If you would like to get an early peek at what we are working on, [url=https://novarama.com/novarama-insider-program/]just sign up here[/url]!

Thank you so much for all your input and help. And please, if you have any questions or feedback, write it all down in the comments below.


Until then,

See you in space bounty hunters!

Your Novarama Team

notes.title: New Killsquad update is now available to download
notes.content:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

It’s been a while, hasn’t it!? Although we haven't spoken much recently, it doesn't mean that work on the game has stopped. Back in our studio, behind closed doors, we’ve been working on making Killsquad even better for you, our players. In this update you will find some new additions to the game that we hope will hit that Killsquad crave spot. So, here we go!

First up, Killsquad is getting [b]10 never-seen-before skill upgrades![/b] From now on, each Hero will have 2 upgrades available. One of them with a cost of 1 TEC and the second with 2 TECs. Don’t have enough TECs? Not to worry! Go and play the Spec. Ops contracts and start collecting those sweet TECs right now!

If you are a fan of the Infinite or Elemental Colosseums, we have something just for you. With this update, you will get [b]4 new gear perks[/b] waiting for your disposal. [i]Heal Up The Sleeve[/i], [i]Resting Stash[/i], [i]Prototype G[/i], and [i]Remedial Recovery[/i] can be added to your arsenal today and tip the balance of victory in your favour. Here’s a little brief intro on them:

[u]Heal Up The Sleeve[/u] (exclusive for Troy): pick up a Card, and heal yourself by 1500 hp.
[u]Resting Stash[/u] (all characters, exclusive legendary): reach a Resting Round in a Colosseum and gain 2 of each equipped Gadget (Gadget amount cannot exceed the max, total).
[u]Prototype G[/u] (All characters, exclusive legendary): use a Gadget drone that follows you around. The drone will activate a random gadget effect every 5 seconds.
[u]Remedial Recovery[/u] (All characters): boost your Basic Attacks with 50% lifesteal for 7 seconds. You can use this perk after successfully performing a Recovery.

But this is not all. [i]The Invulnerable Dodge[/i] gear perk that was exclusive to Troy is now available to all Killsquad characters! Now the whole squad can use Invulnerable Dodge without any restrictions. 

From now on while fighting in Elemental Colosseums you can unlock [b]12 new cosmetics[/b] for your heroes! In addition to getting that almighty feeling of victory, you can now also enjoy a visual upgrade in the appearance of your hero too. 

Here is the list of the new cosmetics:

[u]TROY[/u]:
Aerodynamic Boots (Legs)
Ronin Dō (Body)

[u]CASS[/u]:
Corrupted Flux Mask (Head)
Recycled Plate Armor (Body)
The Queen's Membrane (Body)

[u]KOSMO[/u]:
The Doorstopper (Body)
Customized Knight Gauntlets (Arms)

[u]ZERO[/u]:
Shin Pads (Legs)
Champion Belt (Body)

[u]EKAAR[/u]:
Cobra-style Bamboo Hat (Head)
Copperplate Droid Arms (Arms)
Mutation Remnants (Legs) 


And last but not least. We made some changes to the radar in the game. [b]The Radar now shows the position of your enemies[/b]. Nearby enemies will appear as red circles on the radar, while those distant once will be shown as a red glow. 

Those are just the main changes that we’ve implemented. We’ve also did a lot of smaller quality of life improvements too. If you want to know more details about all of the changes, check out our changelog below. 

Hope you will all enjoy Killsquad’s new additions and have an even better time with our game. And as always if you have any questions, thoughts, leave them in the comment section down below.


May the universe be freed from alien scum.

You can see more detail on full patch notes down below, 


Good luck Bounty Hunters,

Your Novarama Team.


[h2]Killsquad Update v.1.4.0.1[/h2]
 
A new Killsquad Update is here! And it comes with many and varied novelties! Let's start with a short summary of the highlights of the new content:
 
+ 10 brand new skill upgrades for our 5 favorite bounty hunters!
+ 4 brand new gear perks that are especially useful in the hard infinite colosseums.
+ A very nice gear perk that was exclusive to Troy is now available to all characters!
+ 12 new cosmetics unlockable by playing in Elemental Colosseums so you can go bounty hunting in style.
+ The Radar now shows the position of enemies.
 
[b]NEW HEROES SKILL UPGRADES[/b]
 
[u]General[/u]
 
[b]10 Brand new skill upgrades[/b] are coming for our heroes. Each Hero will have 2 upgrades with a cost of 1 and 2 TECs. You can now play the Spec.Ops contracts to get the extra TECs needed to get these upgrades!
 
[u]Hero Skill Upgrade Glossary[/u]
 
+ [b]TROY[/b]
• [b]Substitution Technique[/b] (1 TEC cost): Whenever Troy performs a [i]Recovery[/i],he creates a clone that lasts for 5 second(s). This clone deals 10% its normal damage and taunts nearby enemies.
• [b]Tactical Repositioning[/b] (2 TEC cost): Whenever Troy dodges, he drops 3 land mines on the ground. When an enemy steps on them, they explode, dealing area damage to nearby enemies.
 
+ [b]KOSMO[/b]
• [b]Clobberin' Time[/b] (1 TEC cost): After slamming the ground with [i]Whirlwind[/i], Kosmo's attack speed increases by 35% for 5 second(s).
• [b]Ground Tremors[/b] (2 TEC cost): After slamming the ground during [i]Whirlwind[/i], Kosmo launches a seismic wave, dealing 250 damage to any enemy it hits and sending them flying.
 
+ [b]CASS[/b]
• [b]Silent Recovery[/b] (1 TEC cost): After performing a [i]Recovery[/i], Cass [i]Phase Shifts[/i], turning invisible. Reactivating the Skill while invisible will make her carry out an area attack. Exiting stealth or using [i]Phase Shift's[/i] area attack will not put the Skill on cooldown.
• [b]Phased Healing[/b] (2 TEC cost): Enemies killed by [i]Phase Shift[/i] heal Cass based on her max Health (Basic Type enemies heal for 1% of Cass's max Health, Medium Type enemies heal for 5%, and Semiboss/Boss Type enemies heal for 40%).
 
+ [b]ZERO[/b]
• [b]PHD in Death[/b] (1 TEC cost): Allies revived by Zero are healed for an additional (). Health [i]Medpacks[/i] dropped by Zero appear instantly.
• [b]Rechargable batteries[/b] (2 TEC cost): Hitting enemies with Zero's [i]Basic Attacks[/i] charges a sidebar. When the bar is full, the next [i]Basic Attack[/i] will shoot a [i]Photon Bolt[/i] (any Photon Bolt upgrades will apply)
 
+ [b]EKAAR[/b]
• [b]Tracking Shield[/b] (1 TEC cost): While active, [i]Beta Shield[/i] will always point in the direction Ekaar is facing.
• [b]Fast Hands[/b] (2 TEC cost): Ekaar's [i]Basic Attack's[/i] reload speed is increased by 20% while his [i]Photonic bar[/i] is below ().
 
[b]NEW GEAR PERKS[/b]
 
[u]General[/u]
 
There are 4 new gear perks and some are especially useful in infinite/elemental coliseums:
 
+ [b]Heal Up The Sleeve[/b] ([i]Exclusive Troy gear perk[/i]): When you pick up a [i]Card[/i], Troy heals 1500 Health.
 
+ [b]Resting Stash[/b] ([i]All characters, exclusive legendary[/i]): Every time you reach a [i]Resting Round[/i] in a Colosseum, gain 2 of each equipped Gadget (Gadget amount cannot exceed the max, total).
 
+ [b]Prototype G[/b] ([i]All characters, exclusive legendary[/i]): Generates a small Gadget drone that follows you around. Every 5 second(s), the drone will activate a random gadget effect (The gadget effects can be: Static balls/ Vampiric Pond/ Dummy, the King of Dummies/ Armor UP!) 
 
+ [b]Remedial Recovery[/b] ([i]All characters[/i]): Your [i]Basic Attacks[/i] gain 50% lifesteal for 7 second(s) after succesfully performing a [i]Recovery[/i]
 
[b]EXISTING GEAR PERK CHANGE[/b]
 
[u]General[/u]
 
+ [b]Invulnerable Dodge[/b]: Now this gear perk becomes available for every hero (previously was exclusive of Troy) 
 
[b]BRAND NEW COSMETICS[/b]
 
[u]General[/u]
 
There are 12 brand new cosmetics available inside the chests of Elemental Colosseums:
 
+ [b]TROY[/b]:
• Aerodynamic Boots (Legs)
• Ronin Dō (Body)
 
+ [b]CASS[/b]:
• Corrupted Flux Mask (Head)
• Recycled Plate Armor (Body)
• The Queen's Membrane (Body)
 
+ [b]KOSMO[/b]:
• The Doorstopper (Body)
• Customized Knight Gauntlets (Arms)
 
+ [b]ZERO[/b]:
• Shin Pads (Legs)
• Champion Belt (Body)
 
+ [b]EKAAR[/b]:
• Cobra-style Bamboo Hat (Head)
• Copperplate Droid Arms (Arms)
• Mutation Remnants (Legs) 
 
[b]RADAR UPDATE[/b]
 
[u]General[/u]
 
We have upgraded the radar in the game. It is now more useful as you can see where the enemies are placed relative to your character. You can see nearby enemies as red circles and a red glow indicating the position of distant enemies.
 
[b] MORE CHANGES [/b]
 
[u]General[/u]
 
There is more! We have implemented other minor changes that, we hope, will make the game even better
 
+ We have changed the system of [b]Portal Colosseums[/b] to make them more dynamic as we did with Recruit and Veteran colosseums.
 
+ Now [b]blocked cosmetics[/b] are shown in the inventory grid as they do in the shop and you can also see where you can unlock them.
 
+ The plague curse [b]CURSE OF LAÁUME[/b] now has a “smarter” system. Briefly: Enemies appears or not over the time depending on the stress that surrounds the player (enemies nearby)
 
+ The heroes’ [b]description menu[/b] has been deleted. Now you can see the hero info on the Profile menu.
 
+ The [b]rage buff[/b] (that usually Vasperiath Eggs have) has now a red particle on the enemy or vasperiath egg that triggers it, and enemies affected by this buff have another particle to visually reflect the rage.
 
[b]BUG FIXING[/b]
 
[u]Major Issues[/u]


• Fixed a major bug where you can't equip weapons on your inventory if you play using a controller when you finish a contract.
• Fixed a major bug where the prototypes "PIPTO-483" and "KOLE-305" have incorrect cooldown time when you play as client.

notes.title: Heads up on Killsquad’s upcoming price increase
notes.content:
Hello Killsquad and Novarama fans, 
 
It’s Dani here, the Studio Head and Designer behind Killsquad. I wanted to give you a quick announcement that we will soon be increasing the price of Killsquad. It has been a topic of our internal discussions for some time, and we feel that it is the right step to take. Since its release, Killsquad has been polished, beefed up with new content, and new modes were added too. We also looked at other games that are similar to ours in terms of content and size, and we looked at their prices. And after having those chats we feel that 24.99€ / $27.99 is a fair price for our game. We are also working on the PlayStation versions of Killsquad which will be released in the not-so-distant future. With PC cross-play enabled, we want to maintain price parity with the console version too. It would be unfair to charge one platform more than the other. [b]So as of March 18th 2022, Killsquad will be available to purchase for 24.99€ / $27.99.[/b]
 
So how does this price increase affect you?

1. If you bought the game already, there’s no change, worry, or problem to think about. Just keep playing and enjoy Killsquad.
2. If you were on the fence to buy Killsquad, now might be a good time to buy it. You’ll save yourself that extra bit of money.
3. You can also wait until the price increase and pay the full price. That’s ok too. But don’t fret if you’re a bit tight on funding! We will keep offering discounts from time to time, so do watch Steam carefully, or add our game to your Wishlist, and you will be notified when Killsquad is on sale. 
 
In summary, if you have the game already - nothing to worry about. If you don’t have the game and want to buy it - now might be a good time because soon Killsquad’s price is going up. 
 
We hope you understand our decision and our point of view. And as always, any comments or questions, just ask away below!
 

All the best, 
 
Dani and your Novarama Team

notes.title: Xmas event ends and Ranking System’s new rewards are coming!
notes.content:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

Hope you had a great holiday and a blast of a New Year’s eve. It’s 2022, how crazy is that? Now, as they say, all good things come to an end. So as of right now, we are officially closing our Christmas Event. It’s time to put our festive decorations back to the WAHLA Corp attic. We hope that you had a good time and that you were able to score one or two Christmas goodies. And who knows, maybe next year there will be another event for you to enjoy. 

They also say that when a door closes, a new one opens too. What does that mean? Well, it’s us giving you a little hint that on the 16th of January there will be new Wings to earn! So check out our Competitive Mode in a few days and get those Wings! More info about Competitive Mode is explained right [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/910490/view/3118178418871750772]here[/url].

With this update we also fixed some issues and bugs, and some new tunes in the Colosseum rest rounds. If you want to know the whole list of things that we’ve done, check our changelog below.

notes.title: Inferno Mode Update and Christmas Event are here!
notes.content:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

Ho, ho, ho…ld onto your weapons! A brand new Killsquad’s Update that’s packed with new content is ready for you to enjoy. And this is a big one. It’s the endgame content that we promised you a few months ago. And to top it off, we’ve also added an extra bonus for you. A little something to bring the Xmas spirit to your screens. That’s right - the Killsquad Xmas event is making a comeback and is bringing some special gifts to bring you that Holiday cheer.

Welcome to the new Inferno Mode in which we have new Colosseums waiting. First up, we have [b]three new Elemental Colosseums[/b] for you to try and test your luck with. It’s the ultimate test of strength and guile in which you face hordes of alien meat. And depending on the Colosseum you choose, you will face different foes. Although they might be different, the one thing that they do have in common is that they all have a weak spot. They are weak to the two elements of each colosseum BUT they are resistant to every other element that you will hit them with. So take advantage of their elemental weakness and reap some sweet rewards! And by sweet, we mean the all [b]new Legendary Equipment![/b] There is a Legendary Weapon, a Legendary Gear, and a Legendary Prototype waiting for a Bounty Hunter just like you. You can find the new Legendary Weapons, and Legendary Support/Prototype Gears by completing the Elemental Colosseums. You can also find [b]Perks[/b] for the [b]New Customization System[/b] that the Legendary Equipment have, letting you choose what upgrades they can carry to better fit your builds and playstyles.

We are also bringing you the [b]Infinite Colosseum[/b] - a place with no round limit, but with each new wave, it gets harder and harder, until it may be impossible to continue. How long will you survive? You can play the Colosseum like you normally would. Or you can try out the [b]new Competitive Mode with a New Ranking system[/b]. And if you do take on the challenge and go far enough, you’ll be able to mark your name in the New Ranking system. Make yourself a part of Killsquad’s history and be known as one of the best Bounty Hunters in the universe. Depending on your ranking, you will earn a shiny new badge. The higher the ranking, the higher the tier of the badge you get. You will also gain rewards for participating. These rewards aren't subject to your position in the ranking, but more about your individual skill. These rewards will rotate on a regular basis, so if you missed out on them the first time around, you will be able to unlock them later. 

We’ve upped the Core limit of your Skills and Upgrades from 10 to 12, meaning that you now can get [b]two new additional Cores![/b] You can get those additional slots by unlocking the Veteran Contracts and the Spec. Ops. Contracts. So veterans, don’t freak out if you see two new Cores available. Since you’ve already played through those contracts, they’re there, waiting for you to make use of them. We’ve also added [b]new tiers to all the badges[/b] in the game. Now each of them will have the "Jade" and "Antimatter" tier, with new milestones for you to reach. 

And finally, for all of you alien killers out there that also love to spread Xmas joy, we have just the thing for you! Get those bells jingling as Killsquad’s 2021 [b]Christmas Event has now officially started![/b] And with it, we have all new Xmas goodies for you to unlock. We don’t want to spoil the whole fun, so we’ll leave the “discover what you can get” part all to you. But if you can, throw a snowball at one of your fellow squad members. It’ll be fun - trust us. Also, all of the previous Christmas event quests, portraits, and cosmetics are available as well. If you previously haven't had a chance to get them, well now is your chance to get them. 

For more details on what’s in the update, see our changelog below.

And finally, we want to wish you a Happy Holiday and a fantastic New Year! May this time be full of joy, peace, and happiness. We also want to thank you for making 2021 a year that we will never forget. Thank you for being part of our game and in creating a community that we are forever grateful for. 

We’ve heard your feedback from the last Steam News post so please take a look at the update, see what you think of the new content, and leave your thoughts below. And as always, we’re here to listen, so if something is on your mind, let us know. 


Have a great break, all the best, and speak to you soon,

Your Novarama Team


P.S. Killsquad is part of the Steam Winter Sale, so tell your friends about it! The game is 30% off and the deal lasts till January 5th, 2022.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/910490/Killsquad/



[h2]Killsquad Inferno Mode Update 1.3.0.1[/h2]

[hr][/hr]

The Inferno Mode Update is here! And with it comes the Endgame content! Here are some of the new features:

- A new game mode: [b]Inferno![/b] Containing 3 new Elemental Colosseums, each one based on a different combination of the elements, they will offer you new challenges and where you'll be able to find upgrades for the...
- New [b]Legendary Equipment[/b] which you can customize with perks and level up to Vector 150. Find perks in the new Elemental Colosseums, and level legendary equipment by consuming other pieces of equipment. THEY HUNGER FOR POWER!
- What else, what else? Oh yeah, how about the new [b]Infinite Colosseum[/b]? Test yourself against waves of enemies with no round limit. But be careful each wave you advance the Colosseum gets increasingly hard. How long will you survive?
- And how about a bit of competition? The new Infinite Colosseum comes with a new [b]Competitive mode[/b]. Each round you survive you'll earn points based on your performance. If you reach certain point thresholds (not based on ranking position) you'll earn new rewards and will appear in the global ranking to see how you have done versus other players.
- BREAKING NEWS! It seems like Ekaar may or may not be intent in ruining Christmas. Let's hope the [b]Christmas Event[/b] can put an end to his bitterness. With a new portrait, a new Cosmetic, a new Questline and a new Gadget: the Photonic Snowballs. Throw them at enemies (or allies) to knock them down to their assess. Moreover, rewards and quests from previous events are back, so if you are new or didn't get the chance to get them now is your time.


[b]ELEMENTAL COLOSSEUMS[/b]

[u]General[/u]

· [b]The Elemental Colosseums[/b] bring new custom random waves, with enemies that thematically fit and have weaknesses to the colosseum elements. Any other elements will not be effective against them.
· These Colosseums have a round limit of [b]6 rounds[/b].
· Every [b]Elemental Colosseum[/b] rewards you with a Vector 130 Legendary Equipment. You will find different types of Equipment in each Colosseum:

+ [i]The Vulcanic Colosseum[/i]
  	- Enemy weaknesses: Fire and Toxic
  	- Rewards: Vector 130 Legendary Weapon, 2-4 Random Legendary Weapon Perks

+ [i]The Glacier Colosseum[/i]
  	- Enemy weaknesses: Ice and Kinetic
  	- Rewards: Vector 130 Legendary Support Gear, 2-4 Random Legendary Support Gear Perks

+ [i]The Voltaic Colosseum[/i]
  	- Enemy weaknesses: Electro and Corruption
  	- Rewards: Vector 130 Legendary Prototype Gear, 2-4 Random Legendary Prototype Gear Perks

· After the third round we are introducing a new type of round: the [b]Resting Round[/b]. Here you can take a breather, heal yourself with the healing station, and a new chest. In this chest, you can find additional Legendary Equipment, a random perk or a new emote. But how do you open them? Well, that's the [b]key[/b] to the question.


[b]INFINITE COLOSSEUM[/b]

[u]General[/u]

· [b]The Infinite Colosseum[/b] brings a new feature to Colosseums: no round limit. Instead of completing the Colosseum, you are facing off against yourself and trying to beat your own record. But, with the limit removed, comes a big increase in difficulty. Each round you beat will make the next round tougher, putting your strategies and skill to the test while making it extremely hard for you to survive.
· You can play the Infinite Colosseum in [b]Normal Mode[/b] (play Solo or Co-op) or in the [b]Competitive Mode[/b] (play Solo, get your score and appear on the Ranking).

[u]Competitive Mode[/u]

· This is a [b]Solo game mode exclusively[/b]. You can still play the Infinite Colosseum in Co-op but not Competitively.
· When you play the Competitive Mode, you will [b]earn points[/b] through the rounds based on [b]4 factors[/b]:
  	-  [i]Damage Taken[/i]: More points for less damage taken.
  	-  [i]Time Trial[/i]: More points for less time.
  	-  [i]Rounds[/i]: More points for higher round.
  	-  [i]Disadvantage[/i]: More points based on the difference between your hero's vector and the enemy's vector. This is a point multiplier.

· Based on the [b]amount of points you get[/b], if you beat certain point thresholds, you'll obtain seasonal cosmetic rewards and get a position on [b]the Ranking[/b].
· [b]The Ranking[/b] is a global classification where you can see players sorted by their score playing Competitive Mode in the Infinite Colosseum.
· [b]The Ranking[/b] will reset at the end of every season, with an average duration of half a month.
· [b]Cosmetic rewards[/b] will be based on your [b]individual performance[/b]. It will not depend on your position on the ranking for you to get them. You will need to get certain amount of points to unlock certain cosmetic rewards.
. Depending on [b]your position on the Ranking[/b] at the end of a season, you will get a different tier for a [b]new badge[/b]:
  	- [i]Participant[/i]: Bronze.
  	- [i]Top 25[/i]: Silver.
  	- [i]Top 10[/i]: Gold.
  	- [i]Top 5[/i]: Jade.
  	- [i]Top 1[/i]: Antimatter.


[b]LEGENDARY EQUIPMENT[/b]

[u]General[/u]

· [b]Legendary Equipment[/b] is a new tier for weapons and gears, with new looks and 2 new exciting functionalities: they can level up and you can choose its perks.
· You will find all the [b]Legendary Equipment[/b] at Vector 130, and you can level it up to Vector 150 by consuming other pieces of equipment. The higher the Vector, Tier and what Perks the consumed equipment has, the more experience it gains.
· [b]Legendary Equipment[/b] can also be customized via the [b]Perks[/b]. Legendary weapons and gears come with slots to fit perks, which you can get from playing the Elemental Colosseums, giving you the power to create custom Weapons and Gears.

[u]Perks[/u]

notes.title: The Random Colosseum Update is here!
notes.content:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

The latest update is all about the Colosseum’s core system rework. We are bringing two reworked Colosseum modes to the game to give you more variety and more gameplay. Let us tell you about today’s changes in a bit more detail.

[b]Recruit Colosseum[/b] is for those who do not fear the unknown. If you dare to enter this colosseum, you will stand against hordes of randomly spawning aliens. No Bounty Hunter knows what kind of enemy they will face here. Will it be a swarm of easy-to-kill aliens, or a pack of killers led by an even bigger killer! Nothing is certain in the Recruit Colosseum except that with each wave you manage to survive, the next will be harder to beat as enemies will have higher vector and enhancements.

The [b]Veteran Colosseum[/b] is made for those Bounty Hunters who are on the cusp of greatest - or insanity. In this colosseum you will have to use both your brains and brawn. We took the Recruit Colosseum, but we added a bit more spice to it. It’s all about enemy versatility here. You will not only come across waves of aliens, but they also have various random enhancements too! This is the place where you need to engage both sides of your brain, and not just your thumbs. Non-standard solutions are highly encouraged.

Let us know in the comment section below what you think of these changes. We will be using this system as a basis for our endgame update too, so all your feedback, all your thoughts are most welcome. Which colosseum is your favourite, are you having fun with them, and what else comes to your mind when you play? Curious to hear your thoughts. 


Good luck with the waves of aliens out there Bounty Hunter! And as always, read our changelog below for all the details.

Novarama Team



[h2]Random Colosseums update v.1.2.0.1[/h2]

The Colosseum system rework is here! In this patch we've focused on reworking how the Colosseums work in order to make them more replayable. This new system allows us to randomize and enhance the flavor and variety of enemies depending on waves, vector and more to give you a new challenge every time you enter a Colosseum! With this update, we've made these changes available in the Recruit and Veteran Colosseums, and we will use it to its best potential in the Endgame update.

[b]RECRUIT COLOSSEUM REWORK[/b]

The Recruit Colosseum has a focus on freshnes. Each time you enter the colosseum you will not know which enemies you will encounter. Maybe a wave of basic enemies trying to swarm you, or a swarm of enemies led by an elite one! In any case, the recruit Colosseum now contains all enemies you've seen on the Recruit Contracts! 

[u]General[/u]

· Added to the colosseum all enemies from the RECRUIT contracts. Every challenge you've faced on the RECRUIT contracts can spawn at a wave of the colosseum!
· Modified the System of the colosseum
    - More  basic enemies added to the spawn pool from all the RECRUIT contracts.
    - More Elite enemies added to the spawn pool from all the RECRUIT contracts.
    - Each wave you pass it gets harder in terms of vector and enhancements of enemies.
    - Enemies spawns are random. 

[b]VETERAN COLOSSEUM REWORK[/b]

The Veteran Colosseum has a focus on enemy versatility. We want you to feel the Colosseum different in many ways, so in addition to the recruit changes the system also allows a variety of enhancements to enemies that the player might need to find different ways of dealing with them. Imagine how different it is to fight against a rinosnail if it has an anti range barrier or a dolem if it has a full shield instead of HP... Join the challenge and discover the new Veteran Colosseum!

[u]General[/u]

· Added to the Colosseum all enemies from the VETERAN contracts. Every challenge you've faced on the VETERAN contracts can spawn at a wave of the Colosseum !
· Modified the system of the Colosseum 
    - More  basic enemies added to the spawn pool from all the VETERAN contracts.
    - More Elite enemies added to the spawn pool from all the VETERAN contracts.
- Elite enemies and bosses can spawn with random enhancements to add versatility to enemies. Adding another layer of complexity to the fight
	- Basic enemies can also spawn with random enhancements in certain waves to maximize the potential of some enemies to create new dynamics and experiences at the Colosseum.
	- Enemies spawns are random. 
    - Each wave you pass, it gets harder in terms of vector and enhancements of enemies.

[b]BUG FIXING[/b]

[u]Major Issues[/u]

· Fixed a memory leak problem when entering a contract doubling the memory needed for the game each game you play. This also affected the temperature of your hardware.

[u]Fixes[/u]

· Fixed a bug with the controller that removed the help hoovers if the player opens them with "L3" too fast.
· Fixed a bug with reward screen, if the player gets more than 10 units of a reward the number shown was 0.

If you enjoy Killsquad and you haven’t left a review on Steam yet, please, do so now! Each review will help us reach more people. And more visibility for the game means more money for new additions and features to the game even now that it is on full release! So if you have a spare minute, leave a review. Each one really matters.


[b]What are we doing right now[/b]:

· Working on the Endgame Content.
· If your game crashes, a Crash reporter will appear. Please add the details of what you were doing at the time of the crash and send it to us. If you want to, feel free to contact us directly here at [b]killsquad@novarama.com[/b], with your "[u]Saved[/u]" folder ([u]C:\Users%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Killsquad[/u]) attached.

Hello everyone,

notes.title: Killsquad supports SteelSeries devices
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Do we have any SteelSeries fans out here? If so, raise your hands and gather around. WAHLA Corp is proud to announce that as of now [b]Killsquad supports SteelSeries Gamesense range of devices![/b] So now your SteelSeries devices will illuminate based on your actions. A little detail that will give you that extra feel of immersion when raiding alien planets.

[b]List of SteelSeries Gamesense effects:[/b]
[list][*]Heal: Each time you heal or stay in a healing area, peripherals will react with a green color.
[*]Die: Each time you die peripherals will react with a red color.
[*]Revive: Each time you revive peripherals will react with white color.
[*]Starting a contract: Each time you start a contract, peripherals will react with a color related to the character the player is using.
[*]Finishing a contract: Each time you finish a contract, peripherals will react with a yellow color.
[*]Getting chest, credits, etc: Each time you take a chest, credits, or other items, peripherals will react with gold color.[/list]

Have fun and speak to you soon Bounty Hunters,

Your Novarama Team

notes.title: The Halloween Event is making a comeback
notes.content:
Trick or treat, Bounty Hunters?

Why not both!?!

Come over to our newly decorated lobby - we at WAHLA Corp have an announcement to make! We are happy to announce that the [b]Killsquad’s Halloween Event is back![/b] However, as the headline suggests, it's bigger and better than last year’s Halloween bonanza. Take a look at the video below to see what’s in store - if you DARE!!

The first thing that we just have to mention is the [b]brand-new Gadget - the terrifyingly tasty and powerful Hallowtide Pumpkin Cake![/b] Its effects are still not fully known to WAHLA Corp scientists, but we did hear that it has amazing healing qualities and it is rather moist and has hints of vanilla (chocolate not confirmed). This cake though is not that easy of a find. There is now a new quest where you need to find 100 Hallowtide Pumpkins to help the chef make this most amazing dessert ever made during Hallowtide. Once you gather 100 Pumpkins you can claim the quest, and it will give you 13 Hallowtide Cakes. Now, once you get your 13 cakes, you cannot have more. That is the limit. So hurry Bounty Hunters, this treat is worth fighting for!

As you all know, Halloween is all about dressing up. So get that special vibe for your squad with a new cosmetic - [b]the scarily-hillarious Pumpkin Head![/b] It’s available for all Killsquad’s characters.

Since it’s Ekaar’s first Halloween in Killsquad, we wanted to welcome him to the WAHLA Corp family with a special gift. This year he will get his own [b]Ekaar Halloween Skin and Halloween Portrait[/b] like the rest of the squad. And do you remember [b]last year’s Halloween Skins and Portraits[/b]? We are bringing them back too!

All of the Halloween items are available to buy in the shop only during this event! So don’t wait for too long Bounty Hunters. Get them while they last. 


And to all of our new Bounty Hunters out there, we would appreciate it if you let us know what you think about Killsquad. One of the best ways you can do that is by leaving a review on Steam. If you have a spare minute for us, it would mean the world. 


That’s it from us, enjoy Halloween, and speak to you soon,

Your Novarama Team

notes.title: Killsquad - One week to go
notes.content:
Welcome Bounty Hunters,

We’re one week away. Wow. That was quite a journey!

Our last Early Access BETA Test and Early Access Tokens Special Event are done. So, we are fully focused on Killsquad’s 1.0 Release, which is happening this [b]21st of October[/b]. The game looks healthy. Reviews look healthy (thanks everyone! We’re on the verge of that 70% overall review score we always wanted!). We have a few awesome content creators who will be streaming the game next weekend. It’s gonna be a week to remember.

But, before we get there, all of us here at Novarama thought that it might be nice to sweeten that waiting time a bit. And there’s no better way to do that than with a small tease of what’s coming after Killsquad’s 1.0 Full Release. That’s right - this is not the end of our plans for the game. In fact, you might say that it’s a new beginning!

With the bonanza that was our last year’s Halloween event, we can now confirm that it’s making a comeback! That’s right, the spooky spectacular Killsquad spectacle is coming this year too. Stay tuned as more details are incoming really soon.

And that’s not all. Killsquad will get a proper end-game: [b]Inferno Mode[/b], [b]Legendary Weapons[/b], and [b]the Impossible and Random Colosseums[/b] all drop between now and the new year. We will tell you more about them at length over the coming weeks. But in short, we took in your feedback, we threw in some ideas of our own, and hopefully we came up with a cocktail of hack’n’slash goodness that you’ll enjoy over and over again. As a secret surprise, we want to give Killsquad a competitive edge as well, so get ready. Do you think you’re the best bounty hunter? You’re gonna have to prove your worth against the other bounty hunters from the community, soon.

As some of you may know, Momma and The WAHLA Corp LOVE Xmas. So it’s only fair that we will celebrate it in style too. Get those Xmas jumpers dry cleaned people, as this will get serious.

So yes, rest assured. Next week is gonna be all about the launch. But the team is already working on new stuff. And we feel you’re gonna love it. Expect a full update soon.

Last, but not least, we want to thank you. Thank you for your support, for believing in us and our game, for all your suggestions, and help. Without you, Killsquad would not be the way it is. So once again, thank you! Great journeys require great travel companions, and we couldn’t think of a better crew to cross these long two years, than you guys.

Of course, we want to ask you for a favor too. The final one until release, I guess. Since Killsquad 1.0 Full Release is coming closer and closer, if you haven’t left a review on Steam, please take some time and consider doing it now. It is really important for us. Why? Because releasing with good reviews means more visibility. More sales. More funds to make the game even better. 

That’s it for today. If you have any questions, thoughts, comments, write them below. We are here for you. Hope you had some fun with our BETA test and that you collected a sweet amount of Tokens too. And remember, in less than a week we will celebrate Killsquad’s Full Release!


Speak to you soon,

Your Novarama Team

notes.title: Last BETA test before the 1.0 Full Release = last chance to get BETA skins pack!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are coming with a small, but oh so important, announcement. If you want to get your hands on the unique BETA skins pack, and you haven’t done it yet, this is your [b]LAST CHANCE[/b] to do it! 

Our very last [b]Killsquad BETA test[/b] is on right now! Don’t wait too long though since it [b]ends on Friday, 15th of October.[/b] You have only 7 days to take part in it and get your rare skins. After that date, they are gone forever!

Do it now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/7062d8d728d19c710577553dcb3c50b182170a0d.jpg[/img]
[i]Skins for BETA testers.[/i]

Before we wave goodbye, we have one more important thing to point out. Please, [b]make sure you save your game on the Cloud.[/b] This is crucial. In case you lose your save, change your PC device, or just anything else, it’s always good to have a backup copy of your save game. If you take a part in our BETA test and get for yourself a skink pack it will be saved only on your local save. If you will lose your save, and with it your BETA skin pack, unfortunately, we will not be able to do anything about it. So please, please make sure you will use the Cloud.

Here are all the instructions you might find useful.


[b]How to store your progress in the Cloud:[/b]

By Default, your progress is stored locally on a PC. We highly recommend enabling Steam Cloud to avoid progression loss when switching computers or formatting your PC. To do so, please follow these instructions:

Right Click on the game > properties
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/d18392a7e9125d43fce539f92312a47adc08bd80.png[/img]

It will open a window. In the General Section Check the box at "keep the save game on Steam Cloud"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/b6370748115477d6036aaf9756d5c386fb79d78e.png[/img]
That's it.

Thank you for your attention Bounty Hunters. No go out there and get those sweet BETA cosmetics for yourselves and show some style on the battlefield!


Speak to you soon,

Novarama Team


P.S. Don’t know what to do to join our Killquad BETA test? Have some doubts? Just read all the instructions below.



[b]How to join the BETA:[/b]

Go to your Steam Library and right-click on Killsquad. From there, follow the next steps:

Click on Properties > Betas > Enter the next code [b]m9XVbZvCRv3bwxeF[/b] > Check Code

Now you will have the option to select the "beta - Beta Channel" on the beta programs! (if for any reason you can't find the beta program, try restarting Steam).

[b]How to make a report:[/b]

Even though it is not necessary to follow all the guidelines, this format would help us to grasp all the necessary information in the shortest amount of time. [u]A summary of the error is a must.[/u]

Please, use the Discord channel beta-bug-report to report your bugs. For crashes and fatal errors, send an email here at [u]killsquad@novarama.com.[/u]

[b]An example of a report:[/b]

[u]Summary:[/u] I can't buy any item with any vendor while playing on any contract. Can you reproduce it?: Yes
[u]Description:[/u] When I play on any contract and I try to buy anything on a Vendor, the "Buy" button appears glitched and I can't buy anything! This happened right after the update. Steps to reproduce: Go to any contract and find a vendor. There, try to buy anything.
[u]Files:[/u] Screenshot.jpg

[b]An example of a shorter report (still valid):[/b]

[u]Summary:[/u] Multiplayer of 2, playing as a client
[u]Description:[/u] The game crashes when I'm fighting Helldorren (Veteran) and I use the shuriken when he is doing the spinning attack.
[u]Files:[/u] Crash_Helldorren.zip

If the game crashes, please send us the crash folder at [u]killsquad@novarama.com.[/u]

You can copy and paste the folder location at your explorer: [u]C:\Users\%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Killsquad\Saved[/u]

If the game crashes "randomly", please include all the details of what you were doing until that moment. Every bit of information helps us tremendously to be more efficient with our schedule.

Please remember that the progress you make in the beta won't be transferred/synced with the public, final version.

notes.title: Pre-release Update
notes.content:
Bounty Hunters,

Welcome to the Killsquad Pre Release Update! This is our last step on our journey through Early Access. We've focused on polish and a few on-demand mechanics as requested by you. Of course, being part of our Early Access community, you guys get to enjoy it first. 

Here’s a summary of what’s included in this update:

[b]"Recovery"[/b] has been added to the game by popular demand, "Recovery" is a new mechanic where after being knocked back you can get up back into the fight faster, so you can avoid those nasty moments of knockback after knockback. This short opportunity to get back up by reacting at the right moment will help you keep the frenzy of the battle!

The [b]economy of the game[/b] has been tweaked as well, balancing a bit the importance of the shop, leaning more towards contract rewards with the new "ambush chest". Inside of them you can find and earn that sweet rare loot. We also balanced the rewards for some contracts to smooth the progression throughout all the difficulties!

[b]Single-player balance[/b]! All contracts from Recruit, Veteran and Plague contracts received a balance on time and difficulties. Now the progression curve should be a lot smoother. But don't worry, there are still some more harsh contracts for those seeking greater challenges!

[b]WASTELAND 7A received its last flavour asset pack[/b], with the laboratory theme now added to the map, giving it a unique identity to the world as a post-nuclear planet!

Also, there’s a lot more in there, such as polishing, more balance and bug fixing, a lot of bug fixing, and more bug fixing!

The update is now ready for you to download & enjoy. Please let us know your thoughts below. Finally, two last-minute requests:

[list]
[*]If you have friends who would like to try Killsquad, tell them to get it now. We will be rising prices soon for the public release, and we want you guys & your friends to enjoy it at the best possible price.
[*]If you haven’t done so already, and think we’re doing a good job, please consider leaving a review! We’re at a 69.50 review score now, we’d love to hit 70 before release, as that means the game moves to “Mostly Positive” reviews from “Mixed”. Every review counts, so if you have a spare minute or two, please leave one. You have no idea how much that will help us on release day.
[/list]
 

Until next time, Bounty Hunters!

Your Novarama Team



[h2]Killsquad pre release Update v0.20.9.3[/h2]

[b]RECOVERY[/b]

By popular demand, we've added a Recovery mechanic to the game. You have a small window of opportunity to get up back into the fight!

[u]General[/u]

· Added the new Recovery mechanic. to use it, press the "Dash" key/button (Space bar by default with a keyboard), as soon as your character touches the floor when receiving a knockback. Your character will recover and it won't consume any Dash charge.

When the character is knocked back has a chance to get back up quickly:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/6f6ea5c9b1b7e71c9a0ada586d39f8ec2c51b8bc.gif[/img]


Keep in mind that the window of opportunity is small (as shown with a different color in the next image), less than a second, so you will need to time it well and get skilled to be able to perform the Recovery.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/f4f9e4217c125777733e2ea09b51bba65a929732.gif[/img]


· Added a Recovery animation for Troy.
· Added a Recovery animation for Kosmo.
· Added a Recovery animation for Cass.
· Added a Recovery animation for Zero.
· Added a Recovery animation for Ekaar.

[b]ECONOMY TWEAKS[/b]

The economy of the game has been tweaked, with intentions of leaning more towards contract rewards than a shop buy item rush, specially players without too many resources, with the new "ambush chest" where you can earn rare loot and balancing the rewards for some contracts to smooth the progression through all difficulties to avoid needing grinding in certain parts of the contract progression.

[u]General[/u]

· Added the new "Ambush Chest" mechanic. You can find special chests inside a contract, when opened you will face an ambush but not without reward: a rare piece of equipment!
· Modified all recruit rewards, now the contracts rewards the player with two pieces of equipment at the end of it.
· Modified the rewards at the loot chests from Veteran Contracts, now they can drop gadgets as well.

[b]SINGLE PLAYER BALANCE[/b]

The map received a rework to give a more organic aesthetics to the planet, giving the map a more unique identity with a new biome. The intention is to make the player feel that he's walking over a living creature.

[u]Recruit[/u]

· [b]Knockin' On Heavens Door:[/b] Reduced the quantity of Medium enemies and increased the lifedrop drop chance.
· [b]Doors Wide Shut:[/b] Augmented the percentage of enemies at the beginning of the contract by 20%
· [b]Overprotection:[/b] Reduced the damage for the Enraged Myr. Only for this contract.
· [b]The Dirty Work:[/b] The shield of the vehicle is augmented from 20000 to 25000.
· [b]Hunted Hunter:[/b] Added a widget to the traps to better help players escape it.
· [b]Crazy About Jade:[/b] The duration of the first Jade extraction reduced by 25 seconds. Now a vendor will always spawn between the first and second Jade Extraction.
· [b]Pest Control:[/b] You win more XP during the contrat to reach faster the 10th level. 
· [b]A Hard Nut To Crack:[/b] Reduced the quantity of enemies at the firsts possible paths and augmented the XP gain.
· [b]Hail To The Queen:[/b] Now you always will find 2 elite enemies, one at the begining and one at the end.
· [b]Codename Guerrilla:[/b] Augmented the lifedrop drop chance.
· Augmented the lifedrop chance when you are at 10% and 20% of you HP to all recruit contracts.

[u]Veteran[/u]

· [b]Arachnophilia?:[/b] Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.
· [b]Cleaning is my thing:[/b] Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.
· [b]My humble abode:[/b] Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.
· [b]The profane:[/b] Is now a vector 100 contract and the rewards are from vector 110.

[u]Plague[/u]

· [b]Plague Doors Wide Shut:[/b] Is now a vector 80 contract and the rewards are from vector 90.
· [b]Plague A Hard Nut To Crack:[/b] Is now a vector 80 contract and the rewards are from vector 90.
· [b]Plague Crazy About Jade:[/b] Is now a vector 80 contract and the rewards are from vector 90.
· [b]Plague Hunted Hunter:[/b] Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.
· [b]Plague Codename Guerrilla:[/b]Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.

[u]General[/u]

· Added particles to different mechanics such as the Vampiric Link to further increase the feedback to the player.
· Added a 3D UI to the trap at "HUNTED HUNTER" to further increase the feedback to the player.
· Added a warning to the infinite wave at "POPULAR REQUEST" contract to further increase the feedback to the player.
· Added more minor changes and tweaks to balance some segments of contracts.
· Now you can have only 2 lifedrops at the floor at the same time, a third will not spawn until you use the others.

[b]WASTELAND 7A FLAVOR PACK 2[/b]

The map recieved it's last flavor asset pack, the laboratory theme is added to the world with a total of a new 125 assets contributing to the feeling of a desolate planet.

[u]General[/u]

· Added 14 floor assets.
· Added 3 new shadebars assets.
· Added 5 new watchtowers assets.
· Added 1 new Light prop assets.
· Added 1 new Alien structure assets.
· Added 1 new SM box assets.
· Added 6 new prison tubes assets.
· Added 21 new scaffolding assets.
· Added 53 new generic assets (trashbags, papers, lab equipment etc..).
· Added 2 new barrels assets to the "LAST BASTION" theme.
· Added 7 new cables assets to the "LAST BASTION" theme.
· Added 1 new concrete assets to the "LAST BASTION" theme.
· Added 6 new fences assets to the "LAST BASTION" theme.
· Added 5 new metal plates assets to the "LAST BASTION" theme.
· Added 5 new silos assets to the "LAST BASTION" theme.
· Added 5 new materials to different assets.


[b]AUDIO[/b]

· Added new attack voice lines to all characters.
· Added a voice line to all characters when they are ready at the lobby.
· Added all the new voice actor to Cass and Kosmo. Now all the characters have all the voice lines from the voice actor.
· Added a new ducking/sidechain system allowing all voice lines of characters, NPC's and contracts to be priority over combat sounds allowing the player to hear even in the most intense fights.
· Added a new ducking/sidechain system, giving priority to the character sounds and voices over the enemy.
· Added a new sound for the Ambush chest.
· Added a new sound for the Leave/Disband party.
· Added a new sound for the secondary gear "Kormos4994".
· Modified 40+ SFX from attack, abilities, environmental, movement and animations.
· Modified and improved some attack and weapon sounds.
· Balanced all the attack, movement and voice sounds of all character.
· Improved the randomization of the attack voices.

[b]LIGHTNING[/b]

· Modified all the main menu lightning to change the mood and character visualization.
· Optimized the new lights of the main menu.

· Improved the lightning of all "PALACE OF PAIN" maps.
· Improved the lightning of all dark "WASTELAND 7A" maps. 

[b]GENERAL[/b]

· Added destructible assets to all planets. Now all the maps of Killsquad should have destructible assets.
· Added a shrinking animation to the DNA drops when they are about to disappear.
· Added the possible rewards that can be earned in a contract at the contract card, so players can check and decide before going into a contract.
· Added the maximum vector item that the player can be rewarded in a contract at the contract card, so players can check and decide before going into a contract.
· Added more keyboard bindings to allow players without a QWERTY keyboard to play normally.
· Modified to upper case, the "press any button to continue" for clarity.
· Modified cursor speed while using a controller. 
· Modified the life ability feedback from the "ALPHA DOLEM" to give consistent feedback to the player. 
· Modified all "DASH" videos from all characters to show also the "RECOVERY" Mechanic.
· Modified the videos for "DISINTEGRATE!" and "CEASE TO EXIST!" videos, the new ones have the new particles.
· Increased the chances to spawn the second generation of the "OVERSEER MK2" at "PALACE OF PAIN" maps. 
· Removed all the extra space on the right side of the plague contracts view.

[b]BUG FIXING[/b]

[u]Crashes[/u]:

· Fixed a crash that might occur when picking the green explosive balls at "CODENAME GUERRILLA".
· Fixed a crash that might occur when doing a hold area mission.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when the "NIGHTBRINGER" uses his life steal ability.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when using any drone from Ekaar.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when using the "GRAVITY SHOOT" skill from Troy.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when killing "IB'HU, THE PROFANE" at the same moment of a crystal explosion.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when finishing the three SPEC OPS contracts as a client without going to the contract menu.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when the player respawn at certain checkpoints.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when the savegame is corrupted or modified incorrectly.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when loading some contracts.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when loading enemies.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when opening a chest.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when using the "GRAVITY GRENADE" Skill from Troy.
· Fixed a crash that might occur in the coliseum.
· Fixed a random memory crash when using the any character.

[u]Major Issues[/u]

· Fixed a major bug where the navigation between menus are blocked if you equip a gadget or a talisman.
· Fixed a major bug where the ranged characters could get blocked if you swapped guns while shooting.
· Fixed a major bug where the loot chest rewards were wrong when opening automatically as a client.
· Fixed a major bug where the loot chest rewards could give the same gear or a lower vector gear.
· Fixed a major bug where the traps at the "PALACE OF PAIN" were not rendering for clients.

tags.balance_change: · [b]Knockin' On Heavens Door:[/b] Reduced the quantity of Medium enemies and increased the lifedrop drop chance.
· [b]Doors Wide Shut:[/b] Augmented the percentage of enemies at the beginning of the contract by 20%
· [b]Overprotection:[/b] Reduced the damage for the Enraged Myr. Only for this contract.
· [b]The Dirty Work:[/b] The shield of the vehicle is augmented from 20000 to 25000.
· [b]Hunted Hunter:[/b] Added a widget to the traps to better help players escape it.
· [b]Crazy About Jade:[/b] The duration of the first Jade extraction reduced by 25 seconds. Now a vendor will always spawn between the first and second Jade Extraction.
· [b]Pest Control:[/b] You win more XP during the contrat to reach faster the 10th level.
· [b]A Hard Nut To Crack:[/b] Reduced the quantity of enemies at the firsts possible paths and augmented the XP gain.

[hr][/hr]

[b]AUDIO[/b]

· Modified 40+ SFX from attack, abilities, environmental, movement and animations.

[b]LIGHTNING[/b]

· Optimized the new lights of the main menu.

[b]GENERAL[/b]

· Added the Steam DRM to the game. 
· Increased the chances to spawn the second generation of the "OVERSEER MK2" at "PALACE OF PAIN" maps. 
· Removed all the extra space on the right side of the plague contracts view.

[b]BUG FIXING[/b]

[u]Crashes[/u]:

· Fixed a crash that might occur when the "NIGHTBRINGER" uses his life steal ability.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when using any drone from Ekaar.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when using the "GRAVITY SHOOT" skill from Troy.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when killing "IB'HU, THE PROFANE" at the same moment of a crystal explosion.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when finishing the three SPEC OPS contracts as a client without going to the contract menu.
· Fixed a random memory crash when using the any character.

[u]Major Issues[/u]

· Fixed a major bug at "WASTELAND 7A" where a collision blocked the player from advancing.
· Fixed a major bug at the "CLEANING IS MY THING" contract where you could fall between a door junction.
· Fixed a major bug at "HELLDORREN" boss fight door. Zero's ray was hitting an invisible collision at the door.
· Fixed a major bug where Kosmo could have both ultimate equipped.
· Fixed a major bug where some players did not unlock new contracts when playing contracts as clients in coop games.
· Fixed a major bug where the "RECOVERY" mechanic was not working for clients in a coop contract.
· Fixed a major bug where the decal for the upgrade "HEALING KIT V2.0" was not rendered. Now you will have feedback on when the healing kit is at full growth.
· Fixed a major bug where some skills went underground at some unleveled parts of "KEMMEKH" maps.
· Fixed a major bug with the recently added assets, provoking some enemies to spawn out of bounds.
· Fixed a major bug with the "ECSTASY (KOSMO)" weapon perk. It was not working for client players in a coop game.
· Fixed a major bug when refreshing the shop that could restock with the same items. Now they will be always different.
· Fixed a major bug when equipping a prototype gear. Sometimes when doing so, the support gear will change for another random gear.
· Fixed a major bug when having more than one screen. Now the mouse will not move to another screen without tabbing out.
· Fixed a major bug when the player opens the menu while moving or shooting. The character kept moving or shooting with the menu open.
· Fixed a major bug when a client player in a coop game stops seeing the meteorites falling after activating the car.
· Fixed a major bug when the "CURSE OF KAEJJTU" (damage if separated). Was doing damage if a player enters a seed at "POPULAR REQUEST" contract.
· Fixed a major bug when a client can't see any enemies after dying inside a crystal of the "IB'HU, THE PROFANE" boss battle.
· Fixed a major bug when stacking cooldown reduction blocking the dodge from working.

[u]Fixes[/u]:

· Fixed a bug where the emotes gained by a chest did not appear in the top right corner as pickables do.
· Fixed a bug where the rarity shown for emotes at the reward view was common (gray color) instead of rare (blue color).
· Fixed a bug where the contracts "DOORS WIDE SHUT" and "THE DIRTY WORK" showed the possible reward duplicated at the contract card tooltip.
· Fixed a bug where the destruction of the new destructible box asset did not replicate to clients.
· Fixed a bug where the voting number at the plague totems were showing a parenthesis instead of a number.
· Fixed a bug where the yellow dot alert was not showing to new skins.
· Fixed a bug where the scale of the discord logo was wrong.
· Fixed a bug when using any animation with the "SHARP SPIKES ARMOR". A spike of the armor was not animated. 
· Fixed a bug when joining a coop game or leaving a coop game where an empty map was shown for a moment.
· Fixed some minor collision errors at WASTELAND 7A.


[b]What are we doing right now[/b]:

· Last steps for the 1.0
· If your game crashes, a Crash reporter will appear. Please add the details of what you were doing at the time of the crash and send it to us. If you want to, feel free to contact us directly here at [b]killsquad@novarama.com[/b], with your "[u]Saved[/u]" folder ([u]C:\Users%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Killsquad[/u]) attached.
