notes.title: Take part in Killsquad’s BETA test and grab a free cosmetics pack!
notes.content:
Welcome Bounty Hunters,


Our next Killsquad BETA test is on, and we need Bounty Hunters just like yourself to test our latest content. 

As a reward for your service, you will receive a unique skin pack that’s available to BETA testers only! So join the BETA and show off your loyalty to the WAHLA Corp cause in style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/7062d8d728d19c710577553dcb3c50b182170a0d.jpg[/img]
[i]Skins for BETA testers.[/i]

[b]How to join the BETA:[/b] 

Go to your Steam Library and right-click on Killsquad. From there, follow the next steps: 

Click on Properties > Betas > Enter the next code [b]m9XVbZvCRv3bwxeF[/b] > Check Code 

Now you will have the option to select the "beta - Beta Channel" on the beta programs! (if for any reason you can't find the beta program, try restarting Steam). 

[b]How to make a report:[/b]

Even though it is not necessary to follow all the guidelines, this format would help us to grasp all the necessary information in the shortest amount of time. [u]A summary of the error is a must.[/u] 

Please, use the Discord channel beta-bug-report to report your bugs. For crashes and fatal errors, send an email here at [u]killsquad@novarama.com.[/u]

[b]An example of a report:[/b] 

[u]Summary:[/u] I can't buy any item with any vendor while playing on any contract. Can you reproduce it?: Yes
[u]Description:[/u] When I play on any contract and I try to buy anything on a Vendor, the "Buy" button appears glitched and I can't buy anything! This happened right after the update. Steps to reproduce: Go to any contract and find a vendor. There, try to buy anything. 
[u]Files:[/u] Screenshot.jpg

[b]An example of a shorter report (still valid):[/b]

[u]Summary:[/u] Multiplayer of 2, playing as a client
[u]Description:[/u] The game crashes when I'm fighting Helldorren (Veteran) and I use the shuriken when he is doing the spinning attack.
[u]Files:[/u] Crash_Helldorren.zip

If the game crashes, please send us the crash folder at [u]killsquad@novarama.com.[/u] 

You can copy and paste the folder location at your explorer: [u]C:\Users\%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Killsquad\Saved[/u]

If the game crashes "randomly", please include all the details of what you were doing until that moment. Every bit of information helps us tremendously to be more efficient with our schedule.

Please remember that the progress you make in the beta won't be transferred/synced with the public, final version.


Thank you for your dedication Bounty Hunters. Good luck up there, and enjoy the new cosmetics!


Speak to you soon,

Novarama Team

[h2]Killsquad pre release BETA Update v.0.20.2_beta.16[/h2]

[b]PSA[/b]: [u]Please remember that the progress you make in the beta, won't be shared with the public version. The public version will be available in a couple of days.[/u]

To learn more about betas, please check the following FAQ:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/910490/discussions/0/3093383255707217200/

[hr][/hr]

The Killsquad 1.0 update is here! On this last step on our journey through the Early Access, we've focused on polish and a few on demand mechanics:

"Recovery" has been added to the game by popular demand, "Recovery" is a new mechanic where after being knocked back you can get up into the fight again faster, so you can avoid those nasty moments of knockback after knockback, a short opportunity to get back up by reacting at the right moment and to keep the frenzy of the battle!

The economy of the game has been tweaked, balancing a bit the importance of the shop leaning more towards contract rewards with the new "ambush chest" where you can earn rare loot and balancing the rewards for some contracts to smooth the progression through all difficulties!

Single player balance! All contracts from recruit, Veteran and Plague contracts received a balance on time and difficulties, now the progression curve should be smoother. But don't worry, there is still some more harsh contracts for those seeking greater challenges!

WASTELAND 7A received its last flavor asset pack, the laboratory theme is added to the world, giving its unique identity to the world as a post nuclear planet!

And many more such as polishing, more balance and bug fixing, a lot of bug fixing!

[b]RECOVERY[/b]

By popular demand, we've added a Recovery mechanic to the game. You have a small window of opportunity to get up back into the fight!

[u]General[/u]

· Added the new Recovery mechanic. to use it, press the "Dash" key/button (Space bar by default with a keyboard), as soon as your character touches the floor when receiving a knockback. Your character will recover and it won't consume any Dash charge.

When the character is knocked back has a chance to get back up quickly:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/6f6ea5c9b1b7e71c9a0ada586d39f8ec2c51b8bc.gif[/img]

Keep in mind that the window of opportunity is small (as shown with a different color in the next image), less than a second, so you will need to time it well and get skilled to be able to perform the Recovery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/f4f9e4217c125777733e2ea09b51bba65a929732.gif[/img]

· Added a Recovery animation for Troy.
· Added a Recovery animation for Kosmo.
· Added a Recovery animation for Cass.
· Added a Recovery animation for Zero.
· Added a Recovery animation for Ekaar.

[b]ECONOMY TWEAKS[/b]

The economy of the game has been tweaked, with intentions of leaning more towards contract rewards than a shop buy item rush, specially players without too many resources, with the new "ambush chest" where you can earn rare loot and balancing the rewards for some contracts to smooth the progression through all difficulties to avoid needing grinding in certain parts of the contract progression.

[u]General[/u]

· Added the new "Ambush Chest" mechanic. You can find special chests inside a contract, when opened you will face an ambush but not without reward: a rare piece of equipment!
· Modified all recruit rewards, now the contracts rewards the player with two pieces of equipment at the end of it.
· Modified the rewards at the loot chests from Veteran Contracts, now they can drop gadgets as well.

[b]SINGLE PLAYER BALANCE[/b]

The map received a rework to give a more organic aesthetics to the planet, giving the map a more unique identity with a new biome. The intention is to make the player feel that he's walking over a living creature.

[u]Recruit[/u]

· [b]Knockin' On Heavens Door:[/b] Reduced the quantity of Medium enemies and increased the lifedrop drop chance.
· [b]Doors Wide Shut:[/b] Augmented the percentage of enemies at the beginning of the contract by 20%
· [b]Overprotection:[/b] Reduced the damage for the Enraged Myr. Only for this contract.
· [b]The Dirty Work:[/b] The shield of the vehicle is augmented from 20000 to 25000.
· [b]Hunted Hunter:[/b] Added a widget to the traps to better help players escape it.
· [b]Crazy About Jade:[/b] The duration of the first Jade extraction reduced by 25 seconds. Now a vendor will always spawn between the first and second Jade Extraction.
· [b]Pest Control:[/b] You win more XP during the contrat to reach faster the 10th level. 
· [b]A Hard Nut To Crack:[/b] Reduced the quantity of enemies at the firsts possible paths and augmented the XP gain.
· [b]Hail To The Queen:[/b] Now you always will find 2 elite enemies, one at the begining and one at the end.
· [b]Codename Guerrilla:[/b] Augmented the lifedrop drop chance.
· Augmented the lifedrop chance when you are at 10% and 20% of you HP to all recruit contracts.

[u]Veteran[/u]

· [b]Arachnophilia?:[/b] Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.
· [b]Cleaning is my thing:[/b] Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.
· [b]My humble abode:[/b] Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.
· [b]The profane:[/b] Is now a vector 100 contract and the rewards are from vector 110.

[u]Plague[/u]

· [b]Plague Doors Wide Shut:[/b] Is now a vector 80 contract and the rewards are from vector 90.
· [b]Plague A Hard Nut To Crack:[/b] Is now a vector 80 contract and the rewards are from vector 90.
· [b]Plague Crazy About Jade:[/b] Is now a vector 80 contract and the rewards are from vector 90.
· [b]Plague Hunted Hunter:[/b] Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.
· [b]Plague Codename Guerrilla:[/b]Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.

[u]General[/u]

· Added particles to different mechanics such as the Vampiric Link to further increase the feedback to the player.
· Added a 3D UI to the trap at "HUNTED HUNTER" to further increase the feedback to the player.
· Added a warning to the infinite wave at "POPULAR REQUEST" contract to further increase the feedback to the player.
· Added more minor changes and tweaks to balance some segments of contracts.
· Now you can have only 2 lifedrops at the floor at the same time, a third will not spawn until you use the others.

[b]WASTELAND 7A FLAVOR PACK 2[/b]

The map recieved it's last flavor asset pack, the laboratory theme is added to the world with a total of a new 125 assets contributing to the feeling of a desolate planet.

[u]General[/u]

· Added 14 floor assets.
· Added 3 new shadebars assets.
· Added 5 new watchtowers assets.
· Added 1 new Light prop assets.
· Added 1 new Alien structure assets.
· Added 1 new SM box assets.
· Added 6 new prison tubes assets.
· Added 21 new scaffolding assets.
· Added 53 new generic assets (trashbags, papers, lab equipment etc..).
· Added 2 new barrels assets to the "LAST BASTION" theme.
· Added 7 new cables assets to the "LAST BASTION" theme.
· Added 1 new concrete assets to the "LAST BASTION" theme.
· Added 6 new fences assets to the "LAST BASTION" theme.
· Added 5 new metal plates assets to the "LAST BASTION" theme.
· Added 5 new silos assets to the "LAST BASTION" theme.
· Added 5 new materials to different assets.


[b]AUDIO[/b]

· Added new attack voice lines to all characters.
· Added a voice line to all characters when they are ready at the lobby.
· Added all the new voice actor to Cass and Kosmo. Now all the characters have all the voice lines from the voice actor.
· Added a new ducking/sidechain system allowing all voice lines of characters, NPC's and contracts to be priority over combat sounds allowing the player to hear even in the most intense fights.
· Added a new ducking/sidechain system, giving priority to the character sounds and voices over the enemy.
· Added a new sound for the Ambush chest.
· Added a new sound for the Leave/Disband party.
· Added a new sound for the secondary gear "Kormos4994".
· Modified and improved some attack and weapon sounds.
· Balanced all the attack, movement and voice sounds of all character.
· Improved the randomization of the attack voices.

[b]LIGHTNING[/b]

· Modified all the main menu lightning to change the mood and character visualization.
· Improved render target on the profile menu.

[b]GENERAL[/b]

· Added destructible assets to all planets. Now all the maps of Killsquad should have destructible assets.
· Added a shrinking animation to the DNA drops when they are about to disappear.
· Added the possible rewards that can be earned in a contract at the contract card, so players can check and decide before going into a contract.
· Added the maximum vector item that the player can be rewarded in a contract at the contract card, so players can check and decide before going into a contract.
· Added more keyboard bindings to allow players without a QWERTY keyboard to play normally.
· Modified to upper case, the "press any button to continue" for clarity.
· Modified cursor speed while using a controller. 
· Modified the life ability feedback from the "ALPHA DOLEM" to give consistent feedback to the player. 

[b]BUG FIXING[/b]

[u]Crashes[/u]:

· Fixed a crash that might occur when picking the green explosive balls at "CODENAME GUERRILLA".
· Fixed a crash that might occur when doing a hold area mission.
· Fixed a crash that might occur in the coliseum.

[u]Major Issues[/u]

· Fixed a major bug where the navigation between menus are blocked if you equip a gadget or a talisman.
· Fixed a major bug where the ranged characters could get blocked if you swapped guns while shooting.
· Fixed a major bug where the loot chest rewards were wrong when opening automatically as a client.
· Fixed a major bug where the loot chest rewards could give the same gear or a lower vector gear.
· Fixed a major bug where the traps at the "PALACE OF PAIN" were not rendering for clients.
· Fixed a major bug where the player could not see other players when teleported to the boss area.
· Fixed a major bug where the second part of the "THE PLAGUE IS HERE" quest was not completed at plague contracts.
· Fixed a major bug where the pills from the Zero Skill "SELF MEDICATION" went through walls.
· Fixed a major bug where the "EXTRA SPEED AFTER DODGING" did not work with the "EXTRA SPEED AFTER DODGE" from "CELERITASMOD" gear.
· Fixed a major bug where the HP bars and quest widget are not visible at the "DOUBLE TROUBLE" contract.
· Fixed a major bug where the "HIGER VECTOR LEVEL CONTRACT" curse reduced the damage of your equipped weapon.
· Fixed a major bug where the inputs to increase gadget quantities at the shop are the same for changing character.
· Fixed a major bug where the bosses "CLYDE" and "BONNIE" did not render some decals marking where they were about to attack.
· Fixed a major bug where the music at "TROUBLE IN PARADISE" was getting stuck in a loop.
· Fixed a major bug where the reward was a weapon from V105 at the first contract.
· Fixed a major bug where the lights at the world "PALACE OF PAIN" in plague version where too bright.
· Fixed a major bug where the description of "SHOWS SECRET CHESTS" didn't explain the intended effect of the perk.
· Fixed a major bug where the player could brake the "CRAZY ABOUT JADE" contract mechanic by walking back to the beginning of the contract.
· Fixed a major bug where the player could skip the tenth round of the coliseum.
· Fixed a major bug where the basic attack and the skills from Kosmo where blocked if you got knock backed while using "STAMPEDE" with the upgrade "CHARGE".
· Fixed a major bug where the player could not get a contract completed after finishing one if he joined mid-contract.
· Fixed a major bug where the quest "HELLDORREN THE EVEN CRUELER" was not completed after finishing "MY HUMBLE ABODE" contract.
· Fixed a major bug where the players in a coop game could not see if another player changed his weapon.
· Fixed a major bug where the UI showed you had your second weapon equipped when you had the first one.
· Fixed a major bug where a player joining as reinforcement to "CODENAME GUERILLA" during the ultimate of the boss fight could not see any HP bar.
· Fixed a major bug where a player could have a different skill/upgrade loadout or no loadout at all if he joined a game when all players were ready.
· Fixed a major bug where the mines of "HELLDORREN" boss did lower damage than intended.
· Fixed a major bug where basic enemies appear at any contract after a restart.
· Fixed a major bug where Kosmo could have both ultimate equipped.
· Fixed a major bug where some assets where loading physics when they didn't need to.
· Fixed a major bug at the "PEST CONTROL" boss fight where veteran "BREEDER WYPRAS" could spawn.
· Fixed a major bug at the "PEST CONTROL" boss fight where the player resuscitate inside the venom area instead of a safe place.
· Fixed a major bug at the "KEMMEKH" maps where after using a vendor the textures resolution were downgraded.
· Fixed a major input bug where the player while shooting or activating some skills opens the ESC menu. Blocking the player from attacking automatically again.
· Fixed some hard to reproduce memory corruption issues.
· Fixed a controller input bug where the player could not click on the pop-up buttons.
· Fixed a controller input bug where the player could not equip or upgrade gear.
· Fixed a controller input bug where the player could not do basic attacks.

· Fixed a bug where the invisibility icon at the minimap from cass shill "PHASE SHIFT" was not shown.

· Fixed a bug where particles of the "EXTRA SPEED AFTER DODGE" were misplaced.

tags.feature: "Recovery" has been added to the game by popular demand, "Recovery" is a new mechanic where after being knocked back you can get up into the fight again faster, so you can avoid those nasty moments of knockback after knockback, a short opportunity to get back up by reacting at the right moment and to keep the frenzy of the battle!

tags.balance_change: The economy of the game has been tweaked, balancing a bit the importance of the shop leaning more towards contract rewards with the new "ambush chest" where you can earn rare loot and balancing the rewards for some contracts to smooth the progression through all difficulties!

Single player balance! All contracts from recruit, Veteran and Plague contracts received a balance on time and difficulties, now the progression curve should be smoother. But don't worry, there is still some more harsh contracts for those seeking greater challenges!

tags.feature: WASTELAND 7A received its last flavor asset pack, the laboratory theme is added to the world, giving its unique identity to the world as a post nuclear planet!
By popular demand, we've added a Recovery mechanic to the game. You have a small window of opportunity to get up back into the fight!

Added the new Recovery mechanic. to use it, press the "Dash" key/button (Space bar by default with a keyboard), as soon as your character touches the floor when receiving a knockback. Your character will recover and it won't consume any Dash charge.
Added a Recovery animation for Troy.
Added a Recovery animation for Kosmo.
Added a Recovery animation for Cass.
Added a Recovery animation for Zero.
Added a Recovery animation for Ekaar.

tags.balance_change: The economy of the game has been tweaked, with intentions of leaning more towards contract rewards than a shop buy item rush, specially players without too many resources, with the new "ambush chest" where you can earn rare loot and balancing the rewards for some contracts to smooth the progression through all difficulties to avoid needing grinding in certain parts of the contract progression.

tags.feature: Added the new "Ambush Chest" mechanic. You can find special chests inside a contract, when opened you will face an ambush but not without reward: a rare piece of equipment!

tags.balance_change: Modified all recruit rewards, now the contracts rewards the player with two pieces of equipment at the end of it.
Modified the rewards at the loot chests from Veteran Contracts, now they can drop gadgets as well.

[b]Doors Wide Shut:[/b] Augmented the percentage of enemies at the beginning of the contract by 20%
[b]Overprotection:[/b] Reduced the damage for the Enraged Myr. Only for this contract.
[b]The Dirty Work:[/b] The shield of the vehicle is augmented from 20000 to 25000.

tags.feature: [b]Hunted Hunter:[/b] Added a widget to the traps to better help players escape it.

tags.balance_change: [b]Crazy About Jade:[/b] The duration of the first Jade extraction reduced by 25 seconds. Now a vendor will always spawn between the first and second Jade Extraction.
[b]Pest Control:[/b] You win more XP during the contrat to reach faster the 10th level.
[b]A Hard Nut To Crack:[/b] Reduced the quantity of enemies at the firsts possible paths and augmented the XP gain.
[b]Hail To The Queen:[/b] Now you always will find 2 elite enemies, one at the begining and one at the end.
[b]Codename Guerrilla:[/b] Augmented the lifedrop drop chance.
Augmented the lifedrop chance when you are at 10% and 20% of you HP to all recruit contracts.
[b]Arachnophilia?:[/b] Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.
[b]Cleaning is my thing:[/b] Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.
[b]My humble abode:[/b] Is now a vector 90 contract and the rewards are from vector 100.

notes.title: The 5th Gathering of Bounty Hunters | Q&A
notes.content:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

Our 5th Gathering of Bounty Hunters video is here. Some time ago we asked you for your questions, and today we deliver the answers. It’s time for the Gathering to commence.

[previewyoutube=EwaqWKHSR0Q;full][/previewyoutube]
We want to thank you kindly for all your questions you send us through. If your question hasn’t been answered in the video, check below! And if you are worried that you missed out on having a chance to ask a question, don’t fret - we will make more videos like this in the near future too.

And as always, if you have more questions, comments, or feedback, feel free to write them below. 

May your contracts be fulfilled and your guns always fully loaded.


All the best, 

Novarama Team


The remaining questions and their answers.

[b]Abdullah Almazidi @A_Almazidi from Twitter
- Are you planning of adding a random matchmaking system with filters in the future? And is there room to enhance the multiplayer experience? Like when a person disconnects, make it possible to reconnect or when a host disconnects, migrate to another host?[/b]

We do not plan to add a matchmaking filter system to the game or to add new functionality to the multiplayer experience. Our roadmap is set at the moment.

[b]Andi pratama from YouTube
- Is there any plans for u to make the player can costumize the skins? i mean like mix them up❤️[/b]

No, but we will be adding more cosmetics to further increase the customization of your characters.

[b]tehgreg from Steam 
-  Will Chest Keys ever find use?[/b]

Yes, they will have a use at the endgame. You will need to discover the use of the keys there. So keep in touch to future updates to know more about it.

[b]-  How will events like Christmas or Halloween work in the future? If I'm correct, you had to do manual updates to the client, but obviously you won't be able to do that all the time.
[/b]
We are working on a system to make those events to trigger automatically or semiautomatically at the start date of the event.

[b]ZeN (uk)™ from Steam
- Any chance you can fix the unreal client crash reports which eat up memory and cpu usage after an hour?[/b]

We will contact you to gather more information about this bug.

[b]- I hope inferno isn't plague contracts 2.0 (reusing old content to create the facade of adding endgame content)[/b]

The Inferno contract difficulty is still in the design process, and it can change until the release of the feature, so we can’t say much about it at the moment. Keep in touch to future dev-diaries to discover more about it.

[b]- Might wanna have a look at the shop manual refresh as 90% of the time it refresh random stats of the same previous weapon items.[/b]

We are aware of this issue, we are working to fix the problem.

[b]- Optimization needs a hard pass (more than likely linked to the unrealclient pop ups that cause memory leaks/heavy cpu load)
[/b]
We are working on game optimization the best we can, we hope the changes we are doing will fix most of the problems on performance the game has right now.

[b]- Achievements: 39/156 achievement unlocked. 117 of these new ones are broked as I tested; Committed to The Plague - Equip Plague-themed Weapon, Prototype Gear, and Support Gear on a character. All that does is unlock a portrait profile picture.[/b]

They were a work in progress, in the last update they were released and are available and working to all players. Take a look at the patch notes on discord or steam to know more about the state of the game.

[b]Bum from Steam     [/b] 

[b]- Troy's joker weapon doesn't trigger as much as it should. For someone shooting so fast (especially with 40% speed increase) not getting a single proc is weird. A 15% chance should trigger maybe like every 20th shot at most. But instead it feels more like every 100th shot. Compare that to mjolnir from kosmo, his weapon triggers almost every 5th hit when having the same chance but he's also slower. Sounds like a bug to me.[/b]

We are aware of the issue, we are working on it right now.

[b]- Thoughts on increasing suppoer/prototype slots? A question of builds but would require a lot harder challenge to support these kind of builds.
- Will we be able to upgrade the vector of our equipment?
- We have Skill preset, can we have gear presets?[/b]

Not in the near future. Our roadmap is set for the release and the endgame update. But we will take your suggestions into consideration after we finish the current roadmap.


[b]The Big Noz from Steam
- Do you plane to add a matchmaking or a in-game friend list to re-find more easily our teammate?
[/b]
It will not be implemented into the game, but you can check who played with you recently on Steam or even use the join game via a Steam friend.

[b]- Do you plan to add new environments, enemies, weapon effect, etc....after release?[/b]

We will give priority to the goals on our current roadmap. After that, it can be possible in the future.

[b]- do you plan to add more cinematic like the intro to extend your universe?[/b]


We do not have plans to do so at the moment.

[b]Thraenor from Steam   [/b]   
- Can you make an invincibility window when your character gets knocked up? Some enemies can just spam you with hits and you can't stand up and just die :D

As a tease for the release, we’ve made a mechanic to get back into your feet after being knocked down. You will be able to test it at the beta that is coming soon or at the 1.0 release update. We hope you like it.

[b]- Are you going to add a player hub? Where we can go around and buy things, meet people and get missions.[/b]

It is not in our plans right now.

[b]FERDI BINGER MÄHT DEN RASEN from Steam      
- What is about all the resources which are not used yet like radioactive mushrooms, kem-crystals, etc?[/b] 

We are aware of some resources without a use in the game that were added at the beginning of the early access. We do not have plans to use them to create new content, they might get removed, or you might get a reward in credits. Furthermore, we are still discussing the outcome. Keep in touch to future dev diaries as we will inform you of what will happen to them.


[b]- Will there be another currency like "Jade" in future? Because it's such a precious material with no value in this world.[/b]

Not at the moment. Our priority is to complete the goals of the roadmap, what comes in the future is unknown.

[b]- I remember for completing a quest (the skua update) we got a chest, but never received it, will it come and be opened with the keys and if so, you already know what we can expect from its content?[/b]

The chest was a reward from a quest at the beginning of the Early access. It contained reputation of faction. We’ve changed how the faction's leveling works. Instead of getting a chest, you get the reputation directly.

[b]- You probably mentioned this already, but what happen with the plague-sided locked contracts?[/b]

Unfortunately, they were destroyed by the plague and are not accessible anymore.

[b]- When is the next beta-update and can u tell us more about the fullrelease-date and the major changes that will come with it (e.g. an ingame-store).
[/b]
Soon there will be an announcement with the date of the next beta branch and the release. We will announce it by Steam and Discord, so stay put to not miss the opportunity.

[b]Awe from Steam     
- Did you consider enabling all the power ups you equip since start of the level so you don't need to level up through the mission since when you made the perk changes is pointless locking em behind unlocks and levels inside the mission.[/b]

It is not in our roadmap right now. 

[b]Ralk from Steam  
- In terms of mission variety, do you plan to add any additional mission types to the game over time?
[/b]
We will focus on our roadmap right now. Unfortunately, adding new quests or maps are not in it. But we will think about that depending on the performance of the game at the release.


[b]edge2000 from Steam      
- Do you guys have any thoughts on adding a partner character in the single player game mode (like a customized bot of one of the other characters to join you)? I think that would be fun, kinda like a micro party system or the followers from Diablo 3. Thanks![/b]

It is not in our plans right now. If the game perform really well at the release, it is probable that we could do what you suggest.


[b]Astran from Steam
- Why does Novarama like environmental hazards so much that they even make player character themselves an environmental hazard?
(I've re-installed the game, played few games in "veteran" 60+ range, there were few modifiers which turned player into hazards for others - as in you could not be near/far from another player or you'll both lose health - it was disgusting, the game was uninstalled)[/b]

We are sorry you don’t like the environmental hazards,  Killsquad is dark and full of terrors, it can be a dangerous place sometimes were you can find many things...

[b]Truman from Steam      
- Different classes of weapons for each hero would be nice,to differ loadouts and add variety.[/b]

It is not possible at this moment.

[b]WifeStealeR from Steam      
- I want the players can customize like mixing their skins set with one another :)[/b]

It could be that in the future we add a shared cosmetics between characters. But not in the near future.


[b]CL4UD3 from Steam      
- Ekaar, maybe I'm not seeing his potential yet because I've not invested enough time to him but compared to the 4 original classes he just doesn't seem viable right now. Poor rate of fire and range and lacklustre skills. Do you plan on looking at the classes and buffing some that need it ?[/b]

Ekaar is a different character, it might need more time to discover its full potential. In any case, we are doing balancing to further improve the game experience with all characters.

[b]- Would you consider allowing the saving of cosmetic layouts with the different skill presets, so a certain set of cosmetics is tied to a player defined preset build?[/b]

Not in the near future

[b]Kundalingus from Steam      
- Any chance we will see an overhaul of the clunky control scheme in menus when playing with a gamepad?[/b]

We’ve tried to increase the experience with a controller in the last update, we might do another iteration  in the future. The system will not change, but we will try to make it more comfortable for controller users.


[b]aeolusia from Steam      
- I think it'll be nice if we can select multiple items in inventory for salvaging.[/b]

We would like to, but we have more important priorities. When the current roadmap is complete we will think about your suggestion.


[b]The Great Cornholio from Steam      

- Do you plan to add a player hub city with NPC shops / bounty board?[/b]

We do not have plans at the moment.

notes.title: Early Access Mega-Event is Here!
notes.content:
Welcome Bounty Hunters,

As Killsquad's journey as an Early Access title slowly comes to completion, we wish to deeply thank everyone for supporting us in this adventure. 

That’s why we’ve prepared a Mega-Event for you all!

[h3]Exclusive rewards![/h3]

Grab Killsquad before EA ends and earn exclusive skins and cosmetics. To be clear: once Killsquad enters the Full Release, these will never be available anymore, ever. 

We have exclusive content for:

[list]
[*] All Early Access backers
[*] All Early Adopters (those who bought Killsquad [b]before December 4th of 2019[/b])
[*] All Beta testers, so make sure you join one of the remaining betas before Early Access ends! 
[/list]
[previewyoutube=apYqtGbVUro;full][/previewyoutube]

These are the exclusive [b]skin packs[/b].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/dd5f8aba35ca69dd8acfb0409f1ea49e601aa24f.jpg[/img]
[i]Skins for Early Access players.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/efb96b27aec9cb7a3d41ace88a8c817d2010e772.jpg[/img]
[i]Skins for Early Adopters.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/7062d8d728d19c710577553dcb3c50b182170a0d.jpg[/img]
[i]Skins for BETA Testers.[/i]


[h3]Final Early Access Sale![/h3]

But wait, there's more! We know that money doesn't fall from trees. So, [b]Killsquad is now on sale![/b] From today, you can buy the game with a [b]30% discount![/b] Promotion ends on September 6th at 10 am PDT | 7 pm CEST. Also, [b]this is the last Killsquad sale before our Full Release[/b].

Please do keep in mind that Killsquad will come out of Early Access at a slightly higher price point. That’s why we’ve designed this sale: we think price shouldn't be a factor for anyone who wants to enjoy our game. So: do you want to grab Killsquad at the lowest possible price? Take advantage of this opportunity right now!

[h3]We need your help![/h3]

Please let us know in the comments all your thoughts and feedback about the new update. And tell us, which skin is your favourite. And if you haven’t done so already, please consider leaving a review on Steam. These mean the world to us. We’re getting way more reviews recently (and a lot more positive ones as well!), which we are super thankful for: these will give us more visibility for the game when we come out of Early Access. You guys rock!

Check our Changelog below for more details.

Thank you for your attention Hunters.

Until next time, 

Novarama Team

notes.title: The Factions Update is Here!
notes.content:
Welcome Bounty Hunters!

Are you hungry for more rewards? Keen to unlock more goodies? Well, if you do, we’ve got your back. Let us show you what’s coming in this Killsquad update.

[previewyoutube=8fRoOyXaC_4;full][/previewyoutube]

The Faction and Reputation system is something that we’ve been working on internally for quite some time. We looked at your comments and feedback, and we decided to reduce the amount of exp required to go through the Reputation levels. We made it easier and faster for people to level up, making the whole experience feel less “grindy”. We also saw the things that you, the community, might want as rewards from this system, and we based our new rewards on your feedback.

In the last Ekaar update, we changed the Factions section, updating it visually and adding tons of lore of each faction for you to explore and get lost in our universe. With this update, we are adding the final touches: more and better rewards! Many of the rewards that were previously available have been updated, and new rewards added. There are 50 levels of Reputation to achieve, 3 badges, and 14 unique rewards per faction waiting for you to be unlocked, such as special perks, emotes, skins, and lots more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/81ee2503b2209cd501bfc4de1e251721e7386d19.png[/img]
[i]Level up your Reputation level and collect unique rewards.[/i]

So, what are you waiting for Bounty Hunter? Let’s get that Legendary status! 


Let us know in the comment section below all your thoughts about all the new changes to the Factions. We would love to know what you think.

If you are enjoying Killsquad and what we’re doing with it, leave a Steam review. They help us out a lot. And if you are looking for fellow Bounty Hunters for co-op shenanigans, visit the [url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]official Killsquad Discord. [/url]

Good luck Bounty Hunters and speak to you soon,

Your Novarama Team

If you want to know more details of what we’ve added to the game this time, read our changelog below.

notes.title: What’s coming next: Factions Update
notes.content:
Greetings Bounty Hunters,


Soon a new game Update is coming to Killsquad. So it’s only natural that we should tease you a bit so you can prep yourself both physically and mentally for what’s coming next. 

The upcoming Factions Update is all about gaining reputation - and showing it off in style. With it, you will be able to gain new rewards such as titles, special perks, emotes, and those sweet cosmetic items. 

Now, we don't want to spoil too much of what's coming - that would be just plain rude. However, it would also be rather cruel not to show you anything either. So Bounty Hunters, here are some insider looks to just a few of the new skins that are coming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/dc7aa9676d2406bd78c031db7a3655fe76dc713b.jpg[/img]
[i]Troy Consortium[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/afb5ca798beab396fc295e89aefde637b598f4b3.jpg[/img]
[i]Troy Uprising[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/a04ca0dc17b2f82532836bac010abf5a0a2ce165.jpg[/img]
[i]Zero Sentinels[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/3478734978cd40303708cb8dd1521d07742a0139.jpg[/img]
[i]Zero Unseen[/i]

There’s a lot more that’s coming to Killsquad in the Factions update. We will be rolling out more info on the day of the update drop itself. 

And finally, [b]if you like what we are doing with the game, do consider leaving a review on Steam.[/b] Every single review helps us out tremendously. If you could spare a minute or two and leave a review on Steam, the devs who are writing the very words that you are now reading will be in your debt forever. 


All the best and may your contracts be fulfilled.

Your Novarama Team

notes.title: Killsquad Ekaar Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Killsquad Ekaar Update v0.18.9.1[/h1]

[previewyoutube=S67mf--PxZM;full][/previewyoutube]

The Ekaar Update is here! A new Hero is joining Killsquad: Ekaar! Ekaar is coming to the battlefield with his combat drones, each with a special ability such as shields, slowdowns and targeted damage. Combined, they give you a more tactic control of the fight to finish his enemies with a hell blast of his shotgun.

SPEC OPS contracts have received a revision, reorganized sets of enemies, better encounter placements and a general rebalancing giving you the feel of an elite mercenary, as it should be!

And the opportunity to be that elite mercenary is here, Momma has been kidnapped, save her from a new boss with challenging and new exciting gameplay at the new SKUA contract of SPEC OPS Difficulty.

WASTELAND 7A received a new aesthetic pack adding variety to his asset pack for two contracts, giving the map a more unique identity.

[b]NEW HERO: EKAAR[/b]

A new hero! Ekaar is joining the Killsquad. A close range tactician with drones to control the incoming enemies using a directional shield, slows, targeted damage and of course a shotgun to deliver hell in synchrony with his abilities! 

[u]General[/u]

· Added five Emotes for Ekaar.
· Added ten Weapons for Ekaar.
· Added six skins cosmetics for Ekaar. [i](The Halloween skin will be unlockable at the Halloween event)[/i]
· Added four head cosmetics for Ekaar.
· Added two torso cosmetics for Ekaar.
· Added two arms cosmetics for Ekaar.
· Added two legs cosmetics for Ekaar.

[u]Skills[/u]

· [b]Basic Attack:[/b] I wonder how my shotgun would affect your molecular structure... let's try it out.
· [b]Lunge:[/b] Ekaar can dodge once. One dodge is recharged every 2 seconds.
· [b]Superior Being:[/b] Ekaar's [b][i]Skills[/i][/b] have no cooldown, instead needing to use [b][i]Photons[/i][/b] Ekaar refills his [b][i]Photonic bar[/i][/b] over time. Killing enemies also has a chance of dropping [b][i]Photons[/i][/b].
· [b]Alpha Strike:[/b] Ekaar commands his drone, Alpha, to fire a shot to the nearest enemy, dealing 375 damage in a small area. Enemies with reduced movement speed receive an additional 35% damage.
· [b]Beta Shield:[/b] Ekaar commands his drone, Beta, to place a shield in front of him, blocking any small proyectile it comes into contact with. The shield uses [b][i]Photons[/i][/b] as long as it remains active. [b][i]Basic Attacks[/i][/b] that shoot through the shield, knockback enemies and have their damage increased by 25%.
· [b]Gamma Swirl:[/b] Ekaar commands his drone, Gamma, to spin around him, dealing 50 damage any time it hits an enemy and marking it. Marked enemies will drop [b][i]Photons[/i][/b] after receiving damage from a [b][i]Basic Attack[/i][/b].
· [b]DISINTEGRATE!:[/b] Ekaar commands his drones into position, filling his [b][i]Photonic bar[/i][/b] and unleashing a devastating death ray in a fixed direction, dealing 500 damage per second. While the death ray is active, Ekaar cannot use his other [b][i]Skills[/i][/b]. This [b][i]Skill[/i][/b] can be ended prematurely by reactivating it or when the [b][i]Photonic bar[/i][/b] reaches 0.
· [b]Gemini Effect:[/b] Ekaar creates a temporal disturbance, filling his [b][i]Photonic bar[/i][/b] and duplicating all his drones for 15 seconds. Any [b][i]Skill[/i][/b] or effect a drone has is effectively doubled.

[u]Upgrades[/u]

· [b]ABM Lunge:[/b] If you hit any small projectile while performing a [b][i]Lunge[/i][/b] you absorb it, converting each proyectile into 50 [b][i]Photons[/i][/b].
· [b]Gamma's Helper:[/b] Generates a small Gamma drone. When [b][i]Gamma Swirl[/i][/b] is activated, the drone performs that [b][i]Skill[/i][/b] with an increased diameter.
· [b]Marking Strike:[/b] While [b][i]Beta Shield[/i][/b] is up, anytime you would use [b][i]Alpha Strike[/i][/b] the shot will move in the direction of the shield. Once it goes through the shield, the shot will become empowered, increasing the area of the explosion and marking enemies. Marked enemies will drop [b][i]Photons[/i][/b] after receiving damage from a [b][i]Basic Attack[/i][/b].
· [b]Decelerating Swirl:[/b] Marked enemies have their movement speed reduced by 50%.
· [b]Overchargeble Shield:[/b] When 2 [b][i]Basic Attacks[/i][/b] go through [b][i]Beta Shield[/i][/b], the shield gets overcharged. Upon deactivation, the shield releases an energy wave dealing 300 area damage. Enemies hit by [b][i]Shield Overflow[/i][/b] have a chance to drop [b][i]Photons[/i][/b].
· [b]Alpha's Helper:[/b] Generates a small Alpha drone. When [b][i]Alpha Strike[/i][/b] is activated, the drone shoots a small plasma sphere that deals 50 damage per second to any enemy it impacts with. If it gets hit by a [b][i]Basic Attack[/i][/b] that has passed through [b][i]Beta Shield[/i][/b] the sphere explodes, dealing 550 area damage.
· [b]Insulating Shield:[/b] While [b][i]Beta Shield[/i][/b] is active, if Ekaar receives a hit that deals more than 800 damage, the shield turns into a sphere, granting Ekaar invulnerability for 3.5 seconds. At the end of the invulnerability, Ekaar will heal for 50% of the damage received over 10 seconds. Receiving damage will cancel this heal. Insulating Shield can activate once every 10 seconds.
· [b]Gamma Radiation:[/b] When 3 unmarked enemies are hit by [b][i]Gamma Swirl[/i][/b], a radiation wave is released, dealing 900 area damage around Ekaar.
· [b]Phantom Strike:[/b] [b][i]Alpha Strike[/i][/b] fires an additional shot, but they both deal 20% less damage.
· [b]CEASE TO EXIST!:[/b] While [b][i]DISINTEGRATE![/i][/b] is active, if Ekaar shoots in the direction of the death ray, it increases briefly in length and width and deals a burst of 600 damage.
· [b]Siamese Method:[/b] [b][i]Gemini Effect's[/i][/b] cooldown is lowered to 80 seconds and the duplicated drones duration is increased to 20 seconds. While the duplicated drones are out, your [b][i]Skills[/i][/b] cost 35% less.
· [b]Prototype Sigma:[/b] Generates a small red drone. Every time Ekaar uses [b][i]Photons[/i][/b]  to use his [b][i]Skills[/i][/b], the drone charges. When 200 [b][i]Photons[/i][/b] are used, the next time [b][i]Photons[/i][/b] are used, the drone will start to autodestruct. After a short delay, the drone explodes, dealing 1211 damage to Ekaar, enemies or allies in the area.
· [b]Beta v2.0:[/b] The activation cost of [b][i]Beta Shield[/i][/b] is removed and the [b][i]Photon[/i][/b] usage over time is reduced while active.

[u]Weapons[/u]

· [b]Epiphany:[/b] [b][i]Basic Attacks[/i][/b] have 10% chance of freezing enemies in an area for 1.7 seconds.
· [b]Reactor Chamber:[/b] After hitting enemies with 3 consecutive [b][i]Basic Attacks[/i][/b] [i](without using Skills or dodging in between attacks)[/i], the next consecutive [b][i]Basic Attack[/i][/b] creates a large area for 4.0 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with the area will be poisoned for 4.0 seconds, receiving 20.0 damage every 0.5 seconds, and will have their movement speed reduced 50% for 4.0 seconds.
· [b]Payday:[/b] After 3.0 seconds without performing a [b][i]Basic Attack[/i][/b], you get an attack charge. The next time you perform a [b][i]Basic Attack[/i][/b], you can do a second one without needing to wait for the recharge time.
· [b]Echoing Supernova:[/b] [b][i]Basic Attacks[/i][/b] that are shot through [b][i]Beta Shield[/i][/b] become empowered, dealing 230.0, and have a 100% chance to burn enemies for 5.0, receiving 10.0 damage every 0.5 seconds. 
· [b]Awakening the Nightmare:[/b] You will lose -200.0 life every 1 seconds up to 30% of your max life. +50% lifesteal.
· [b]Ohgur's Roar:[/b] After killing an enemy there is a 40% chance to spawn spikes on the floor that stun enemies.
· [b]Last Frontier:[/b] [b][i]Basic Attack's[/i][/b] are narrower, but have their range increased. Damage is increased 60% against faraway enemies.
· [b]Maelstrom:[/b] 25% chance to spawn 3 missiles on hit.
· [b]Foundations of Rebellion:[/b] [b][i]Basic Attacks[/i][/b] have a 100% chance of exploding when an enemy is hit, dealing 50.0 area damage. Enemies hit by the explosion have a 35% chance of exploding again. The chance of exploding again is reduced by 15% for each consecutive detonation.
· [b]Funeral Bells:[/b] 30% increased damage against nearby enemies. 65% decreased damage against faraway enemies.

[b]SPEC OPS REFACTOR[/b]

Both Spec ops contracts received a revision, modified the sets of enemies, encounters and better placements of waves alongside a general rebalance to match the scaling difficulties of recruit and veteran! But that is not all... Momma has been kidnapped! Rescue her at the new Spec Ops contract. Prepare yourself to fight a challenging new boss with new mechanics and a lot of bullets to spare!

[u]General[/u]

· Added a new SKUA map at the SPEC OPS Difficulty.
· Added a new boss fight with new mechanics.
· Rebalanced both "TROUBLE IN PARADISE" and "CLEAN THE MESS"

[i][b]NOTE:[/b] This section is still in progress, it might change in the public release.[/i]

[b]WASTELAND 7A AESTHETICS REWORK[/b]

The map received a rework to give a more organic aesthetics to the planet, giving the map a more unique identity with a new biome. The intention is to make the player feel that he's walking over a living creature.

[u]General[/u]

· Added more than 30 new materials.
· Added three new environmental Assets.
· Added one animated environmental Asset.
· Modified 2 contracts to add this new aesthetics.

[b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]

We know this is important for the community and here they are. 39 achievements come to killsquad, 5 of them are hidden and will need to be discovered in order to unlock them. The achievements [b]are retroactive[/b], so a veteran player will unlock any achievement they met the requirements for at the first login after the patch. Also, more achievements are in development, so expect new ones in future updates!

[u]Public[/u]

[b]Veteran League:[/b] Training wheels not included.
[b]Spec. Ops. League:[/b] You're playing with the big boys now.
[b]The First Seed:[/b] Defeat the Plague Seed for the first time.

· Added SFX to all emotes of the game.

· Added one new badge.

notes.title: Killsquad Ekaar Beta Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Killsquad Beta Ekaar Update v0.18.3_beta.5[/h3]

[b]PSA[/b]: [u]Please remember that the progress you make in the beta, won't be shared with the public version. The public version will be available in a few days, once testing is complete.[/u]

To learn more about betas, please check the following FAQ:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/910490/discussions/0/3093383255707217200/

[hr][/hr]

The Ekaar Update is here! A new Hero is joining Killsquad: Ekaar! Ekkar is coming to the battlefield with his combat drones, each with a special ability such as shields, slowdowns and targeted damage. Combined, they give you a more tactic control of the fight to finish his enemies with a hell blast of his shotgun. 

SPEC OPS contracts have received a revision, reorganized sets of enemies, better encounter placements and a general rebalancing giving you the feel of an elite mercenary, as it should be! 

And the opportunity to be that elite mercenary is here, Momma has been kidnapped, save her from a new boss with challenging and new exciting gameplay at the new SKUA contract of SPEC OPS Difficulty. 

WASTELAND 7A received a new aesthetic pack adding variety to his asset pack for two contracts, giving the map a more unique identity.

[b]NEW HERO: EKAAR[/b]

A new hero! Ekaar is joining the Killsquad. A close range tactician with drones to control the incoming enemies using a directional shield, slows, targeted damage and of course a shotgun to deliver hell in synchrony with his abilities! 

[u]General[/u]

· Added five Emotes for Ekaar.
· Added ten Weapons for Ekaar.
· Added six skins cosmetics for Ekaar. [i](The Halloween skin will be unlockable at the Halloween event)[/i]
· Added four head cosmetics for Ekaar.
· Added two torso cosmetics for Ekaar.
· Added two arms cosmetics for Ekaar.
· Added two legs cosmetics for Ekaar.

[u]Skills[/u]

· [b]Basic Attack:[/b] I wonder how my shotgun would affect your molecular structure... let's try it out.
· [b]Lunge:[/b] Ekaar can dodge once. One dodge is recharged every 2 seconds.
· [b]Superior Being:[/b] Ekaar's [b][i]Skills[/i][/b] have no cooldown, instead needing to use [b][i]Photons[/i][/b] Ekaar refills his [b][i]Photonic bar[/i][/b] over time. Killing enemies also has a chance of dropping [b][i]Photons[/i][/b].
· [b]Alpha Strike:[/b] Ekaar commands his drone, Alpha, to fire a shot to the nearest enemy, dealing 375 damage in a small area. Enemies with reduced movement speed receive an additional 35% damage.
· [b]Beta Shield:[/b] Ekaar commands his drone, Beta, to place a shield in front of him, blocking any small proyectile it comes into contact with. The shield uses [b][i]Photons[/i][/b] as long as it remains active. [b][i]Basic Attacks[/i][/b] that shoot through the shield, knockback enemies and have their damage increased by 25%.
· [b]Gamma Swirl:[/b] Ekaar commands his drone, Gamma, to spin around him, dealing 50 damage any time it hits an enemy and marking it. Marked enemies will drop [b][i]Photons[/i][/b] after receiving damage from a [b][i]Basic Attack[/i][/b].
· [b]DISINTEGRATE!:[/b] Ekaar commands his drones into position, filling his [b][i]Photonic bar[/i][/b] and unleashing a devastating death ray in a fixed direction, dealing 500 damage per second. While the death ray is active, Ekaar cannot use his other [b][i]Skills[/i][/b]. This [b][i]Skill[/i][/b] can be ended prematurely by reactivating it or when the [b][i]Photonic bar[/i][/b] reaches 0.
· [b]Gemini Effect:[/b] Ekaar creates a temporal disturbance, filling his [b][i]Photonic bar[/i][/b] and duplicating all his drones for 15 seconds. Any [b][i]Skill[/i][/b] or effect a drone has is effectively doubled.

[u]Upgrades[/u]

· [b]ABM Lunge:[/b] If you hit any small projectile while performing a [b][i]Lunge[/i][/b] you absorb it, converting each proyectile into 50 [b][i]Photons[/i][/b].
· [b]Gamma's Helper:[/b] Generates a small Gamma drone. When [b][i]Gamma Swirl[/i][/b] is activated, the drone performs that [b][i]Skill[/i][/b] with an increased diameter.
· [b]Marking Strike:[/b] While [b][i]Beta Shield[/i][/b] is up, anytime you would use [b][i]Alpha Strike[/i][/b] the shot will move in the direction of the shield. Once it goes through the shield, the shot will become empowered, increasing the area of the explosion and marking enemies. Marked enemies will drop [b][i]Photons[/i][/b] after receiving damage from a [b][i]Basic Attack[/i][/b].
· [b]Decelerating Swirl:[/b] Marked enemies have their movement speed reduced by 50%.
· [b]Overchargeble Shield:[/b] When 2 [b][i]Basic Attacks[/i][/b] go through [b][i]Beta Shield[/i][/b], the shield gets overcharged. Upon deactivation, the shield releases an energy wave dealing 300 area damage. Enemies hit by [b][i]Shield Overflow[/i][/b] have a chance to drop [b][i]Photons[/i][/b].
· [b]Alpha's Helper:[/b] Generates a small Alpha drone. When [b][i]Alpha Strike[/i][/b] is activated, the drone shoots a small plasma sphere that deals 50 damage per second to any enemy it impacts with. If it gets hit by a [b][i]Basic Attack[/i][/b] that has passed through [b][i]Beta Shield[/i][/b] the sphere explodes, dealing 550 area damage.
· [b]Insulating Shield:[/b] While [b][i]Beta Shield[/i][/b] is active, if Ekaar receives a hit that deals more than 800 damage, the shield turns into a sphere, granting Ekaar invulnerability for 3.5 seconds. At the end of the invulnerability, Ekaar will heal for 50% of the damage received over 10 seconds. Receiving damage will cancel this heal. Insulating Shield can activate once every 10 seconds.
· [b]Gamma Radiation:[/b] When 3 unmarked enemies are hit by [b][i]Gamma Swirl[/i][/b], a radiation wave is released, dealing 900 area damage around Ekaar.
· [b]Phantom Strike:[/b] [b][i]Alpha Strike[/i][/b] fires an additional shot, but they both deal 20% less damage.
· [b]CEASE TO EXIST!:[/b] While [b][i]DISINTEGRATE![/i][/b] is active, if Ekaar shoots in the direction of the death ray, it increases briefly in length and width and deals a burst of 600 damage.
· [b]Siamese Method:[/b] [b][i]Gemini Effect's[/i][/b] cooldown is lowered to 80 seconds and the duplicated drones duration is increased to 20 seconds. While the duplicated drones are out, your [b][i]Skills[/i][/b] cost 35% less.
· [b]Prototype Sigma:[/b] Generates a small red drone. Every time Ekaar uses [b][i]Photons[/i][/b]  to use his [b][i]Skills[/i][/b], the drone charges. When 200 [b][i]Photons[/i][/b] are used, the next time [b][i]Photons[/i][/b] are used, the drone will start to autodestruct. After a short delay, the drone explodes, dealing 1211 damage to Ekaar, enemies or allies in the area.
· [b]Beta v2.0:[/b] The activation cost of [b][i]Beta Shield[/i][/b] is removed and the [b][i]Photon[/i][/b] usage over time is reduced while active.

[u]Weapons[/u]

· [b]Epiphany:[/b] [b][i]Basic Attacks[/i][/b] have 10% chance of freezing enemies in an area for 1.7 seconds.
· [b]Reactor Chamber:[/b] After hitting enemies with 3 consecutive [b][i]Basic Attacks[/i][/b] [i](without using Skills or dodging in between attacks)[/i], the next consecutive [b][i]Basic Attack[/i][/b] creates a large area for 4.0 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with the area will be poisoned for 4.0 seconds, receiving 20.0 damage every 0.5 seconds, and will have their movement speed reduced 50% for 4.0 seconds.
· [b]Payday:[/b] After 3.0 seconds without performing a [b][i]Basic Attack[/i][/b], you get an attack charge. The next time you perform a [b][i]Basic Attack[/i][/b], you can do a second one without needing to wait for the recharge time.
· [b]Echoing Supernova:[/b] [b][i]Basic Attacks[/i][/b] that are shot through [b][i]Beta Shield[/i][/b] become empowered, dealing 230.0, and have a 100% chance to burn enemies for 5.0, receiving 10.0 damage every 0.5 seconds. 
· [b]Awakening the Nightmare:[/b] You will lose -200.0 life every 1 seconds up to 30% of your max life. +50% lifesteal.
· [b]Ohgur's Roar:[/b] After killing an enemy there is a 40% chance to spawn spikes on the floor that stun enemies.
· [b]Last Frontier:[/b] [b][i]Basic Attack's[/i][/b] are narrower, but have their range increased. Damage is increased 60% against faraway enemies.
· [b]Maelstrom:[/b] 25% chance to spawn 3 missiles on hit.
· [b]Foundations of Rebellion:[/b] [b][i]Basic Attacks[/i][/b] have a 100% chance of exploding when an enemy is hit, dealing 50.0 area damage. Enemies hit by the explosion have a 35% chance of exploding again. The chance of exploding again is reduced by 15% for each consecutive detonation.
· [b]Funeral Bells:[/b] 30% increased damage against nearby enemies. 65% decreased damage against faraway enemies.

[b]SPEC OPS REFACTOR[/b]

Both Spec ops contracts received a revision, modified the sets of enemies, encounters and better placements of waves alongside a general rebalance to match the scaling difficulties of recruit and veteran! But that is not all... Momma has been kidnapped! Rescue her at the new Spec Ops contract. Prepare yourself to fight a challenging new boss with new mechanics and a lot of bullets to spare!

[u]General[/u]

· Added a new SKUA map at the SPEC OPS Difficulty.
· Added a new boss fight with new mechanics.
· Rebalanced both "TROUBLE IN PARADISE" and "CLEAN THE MESS"

[i][b]NOTE:[/b] This section is still in progress, it might change in the public release.[/i]

[b]WASTELAND 7A AESTHETICS REWORK[/b]

The map received a rework to give a more organic aesthetics to the planet, giving the map a more unique identity with a new biome. The intention is to make the player feel that he's walking over a living creature.

[u]General[/u]

· Added more than 30 new materials.
· Added three new environmental Assets.
· Added one animated environmental Asset.
· Modified 2 contracts to add this new aesthetics.

[b]AUDIO[/b]

· Added SFX to all emotes of the game.
· Added voice lines to all characters when inside a contract, now they will talk while fighting.
· Added new SFX when hitting enemies.
· Added SFX for all weapons, animations, basic atacks and footsteps of Ekaar.

· Added one new badge.
· Added three new Portraits.
· Added video tutorials for all Ekaar skills.
· Added four new Quests.
· Added Lore descriptions to all the factions.
· Added a functionality to check the recent Steam players.
· Added a functionality to join a game of a friend using the STEAM friend list without having the game opened.
· Modified the mouse movement at the contract view. Now it should be smoother and less frustrating.
· Modified how the "target" message works at vehicle protection contract. Now if the vehicle needs to recharge the target of the contract will change accordingly.
· Modified some titles from the unseen and the sentinels.
· Removed some legacy tips at the loading screens.

[b]BUG FIXING[/b]

· Fixed a crash that might occur when equipping an emote.

· Fixed a bug at "CLEAN THE MESS" contract where the player HP bar desynchronize with the hp reduction curse.
· Fixed a bug involving a flashing texture of the plague contracts. Now the texture will be rendered as intended.
· Fixed a bug where the "MYR" and "ENRAGE MYR" attacks would ignore the shields created by cars or towers in contracts where you have to protect something.
· Fixed a bug where the Hidden TEC's icons on the minimap where shown as chests instead of the TEC Icon.
· Fixed a bug of the Zero gun "ASTRALVERKUR". The shooting SFX was reproduced with a notorious delay between the shoot action and the shot.
· Fixed a bug allowing the player to buy weapons and gear under Vector 5.
· Fixed the descriptions of the "IDOL OF FUTURE CONQUERORS" and "TOTEMS OF PAST LEGENDS" Talismans.
· Fixed some Spanish localizations bugs.

[b]What are we doing right now[/b]:

If you want to, feel free to contact us directly here at [b]killsquad@novarama.com[/b], with your "[u]Saved[/u]" folder ([u]C:\Users%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Killsquad[/u]) attached.

notes.title: Dev Diary Update
notes.content:
Hello Bounty hunters!

Just a very quick update today really. 

1) Thank you to the more than 2000 people who have purchased Killsquad in the last 2 weeks. You guys mean the world to us! All these sales go into funding development, in the spirit of Early Access, so thank you very very much!

2) Thank you to everyone who is posting reviews! These are super welcome by the dev team. If you haven't done so, and think we're doing a good job, now is the time to post a review! Reviews boost visibilility, which boost sales, which goes into... yep! Development!

notes.title: Killsquad: CORE 2 update, v0.17.6.21, out now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=lCgPT7mAZm4;full][/previewyoutube]

The Core 2 Update is here! This update comes with major changes. The skill and upgrade system has been reworked. Now, you can preview, buy, and equip from the skills menu to combine them in new and exciting ways. You will be able to explore these new features with the revamped UI, new interface, interactions and new functionalities such as shop rerolls or ways to save your preferred skill arrangements.

[h3]Updated Roadmap[/h3]

It's been a long journey, here you can see a list of all our game updates, and the roadmap of the upcoming ones:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/e1fc2679875b3f7c84f38af01b532eeb8632a3f7.png[/img]

[h3]FULL PATCH NOTES[/h3]

[b]PSA:[/b] [u]Some of you might notice at the killsquad STEAM page some hidden Achievements. We are currently working on implementing them for the [b]next summer update[/b], so they are [b]not achievable[/b] right now even if they show up.[/u]


[b]PROGRESSION[/b]

In this update we have focused in reworking the core system of the character skills allowing full customization of your build using the new skill tree. Also, and maybe the more important change, your abilities are [b]automatically[/b] upgraded inside a contract using the upgrades and skills you preselected at the skill tree.

[u]TECS[/u]

A new unique currency is added to the game: TECS. They can be earned and found in contracts. Use these TECS to unlock Skills and Upgrades for a specific character in the Skill Tree. Look for them carefully as they exist in a specific amount for each character.


[b]SAVE CONVERSION[/b]

With the new Skill and upgrade system we have a new currency, the TECs, if you have played a [b]RECRUIT[/b] contract with a character before the update, you will receive the [b]reward[/b] TEC for this character and contract the first time you open the game after the update. Apart from that you will be able to find more hidden TECs inside the RECRUIT and VETERAN contracts.

[u]Skills tree[/u]

Added a skill tree to each character, use TECS to unlock Skills and upgrades. Equip them and combine them in new and exciting ways to achieve the play style you like. You will need to buy at least one upgrade from one level to unlock the purchase of the next level, after that you can equip whatever you want even if they are all level ten upgrades. Fully customize your build!

[u]Builds and presets[/u]

Heroes have 10 cores that allows to assign skills and upgrades to their build. Each of them will have a cost, higher tiers will cost more than low tiered upgrades. Combine them in different ways to create the playstyle of your choice! Save the arrangements in one of the five available preset slots to switch between your skills and upgrades!


[b]SKILLS AND UPGRADES[/b]

With the new system we have taken the opportunity of balancing existing upgrades, adding new ones, VFX & SFX. Also, all descriptions have been overhauled to improve readability and give more information to the player. It's well over 70 skill changes, so the list is too long to paste here. Please read this Discussion in the forums for a full list:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/910490/discussions/0/5408241261716113562/]Skills and upgrades patch notes[/url]


[b]TUTORIALS[/b]

New Tutorials for all the new features. When you reach a new system or a new goal in the new progression system, a pop-up will show you how it works. You will be able to reopen this tutorial whenever you want, looking for the interrogation icon in the bottom right corner of the specific screen. We would like to thank you all for the feedback. With this improvement, we hope the features are easier to understand.

[b]UI[/b]

A new design comes to the game alongside major changes at quality of life.

[u]Shop[/u]

A new Reroll mechanic is added to the shop as a quality of life improvement. Now you can pay a little amount of credits to manually reroll the shop stock to look for your desired equipment, we hope this change will ease your grinding for the perfect piece of equipment. Also, as requested, we added a weapon and gear comparison.

[u]General Changes[/u]

· Added an icon to show how many TECS can be found in a contract and how many you already found there.
· Added a new message in the contract selector screen when the host of a game chooses a contract notifying all group members.
· Added new upgrade icons at the skill tree.
· Added an outline to all intractable items to give more feedback to the player.
· Added particle effects in the lobby when a player is ready.
· Added a new special TEC pickup. These items can only appear on contracts indicating it.
· Added new hover popup on currency sections as the lobby, shop and in contract game showing the important currencies for that section.
· Added a new start splash art at the begining of the game.
· Added new a Animation and SFX in the help exclamation marks found in contracts, to better aid players.
· Added feedback while dismantling an item.
· Added in the Codex the icon of the enemy ARISIERA.
· Added in the Codex the icon of the enemy B.O.B.
· Added tutorial videos to preview all the skill and upgrades. You can also watch those videos in the ESC menu inside a contract.
· Changed the color of the rebel faction from red to blue.
· Changed the description of the gear upgrade, "EXTRA CHARGED DASH AFTER KILL (CASS)": It now provides a Charged Dash and not with a Dash/Charged Dash.
· Changed the description of the gear upgrade for Kosmo, "ENEMY DAMAGE REDUCTION": Fixed the text "hitted" to "hit".
· Changed the lighting levels of the contract "A HARD NUT TO CRACK", since it was too dark.
· Changed the description of texts size at the shop to improve readability.
· Updated the UI at the lobby. New visuals before starting a contract improving the feedback to the player.
· Updated the UI at the heroes section. A Centralized section of all the statistics, inventory, character progression, cosmetics and vanity items for all characters.
· Updated the UI at the shop. A clearer interface able to show more information of an item alongside a new reroll system.
· Updated the UI at the player profile. Better view of your statistics, reputation levels and vanity badges/icons.
· Updated the UI at the contract selector. Easier to navigate between plague and normal mode and to select a contract to play.
· Updated the UI at the ESC menu inside a contract. New visuals showing current equipment and your selected upgrades ordered by level. You can keep track on your stats and when will new upgrades be available inside a contract.
· Updated all controls UI icons.
· Updated the items upgrade Icons. Three new status showing when the weapon/gear is updated, when you have enough resources for the upgrade and when the weapon can be upgraded but you don't have enough resources.
· Updated the tutorial video for the skill "EXPERIENCED CLONES"
· Now at the powered gate of the contract "DOORS WIDE SHUT", enemies will start spawning only after inserting the first energy sphere.
· Removed the green and red arrows at the element icons from the enemies in the CODEX.


[b]REBALANCE[/b]

[u]Major overhauls[/u]

· The toxic fallout in "Overprotection" contract now launches a healing area inside the shields to help during the struggle.
· The palace of pain received more monster variation in enemy waves and also added more time to the hold area segment.
· Balanced some HUB segments at SKUA Maps by adding more enemies and pickups. They were empty before the rebalance.

[u]General overhauls[/u]

· Rebalanced all game Recruit and Veteran contracts, focusing on shorter and more fun games.
· Rebalanced all SKUA Enemies.
· Rebalanced all credit rewards after the [b]second[/b] time you play a Recruit contract.


[b]AUDIO[/b]

· Troy received a SFX rework for his guns, with more than 30 new gun SFX.
· Zero received a SFX rework for his laser gun, with more than 10 new gun SFX.
· General Overhaul to the ambient sounds at SKUA maps, adding more than 25 new SFX.
· Added sound feedback to UI.
· Added sound feedback to the Steerable Ball skill.
· Added sound feedback to the Mass Execution skill.
· Added sound feedback to the Emergency Shield skill.
· Added footsteps sound to all SKUA floor types.
· Added footsteps sound to all THE PALACE OF PAIN floor types.
· Added footsteps sound to all WASTELAND 7A floor types.
· Added missing audio in the Queen Maggoth's boss cinematic entrance.
· Reduced the volume of the starting music at the coliseum.


[b]GENERAL[/b]

· Updated the particles when destroying a SKUA ball in an area.
· Changed the color of Kosmo's Berserker Taunt skill. 
· Added a new death SFX to the S.K.Y.F.E.D BOSS.
· Added a new SFX in the Toxic area of the Overprotection contract. 
· Added new particles to the barriers of the Overprotection contract.
· Added four new entrance animations to each hero at the start of a contract.
· Added destructible rocks to WASTELAND 7A maps 
· Added a new dash animation for Lilith.
· Added a new dash animation for Zero.
· Modified the dash animation for Kosmo.
· General review to all "WASTELAND 7A" maps fixing holes or collisions.
· Added a fire spark particle to SKUA maps.


[b]BUG FIXING[/b]

[u]Crashes[/u]:

· Fixed a crash that might occur to hosts after selecting a skill with ZERO.
· Fixed a crash that might occur after a group dissolves and a client tried to play a contract in single player afterwards.
· Fixed a crash that might occur when fighting the final boss at the Spec. Ops. contract, "CLEAN THE MESS".
· Fixed a crash that might occur at the talisman section in the inventory
· Fixed a crash that might occur when two players joined in a lobby at the same time.
· Fixed a crash related to destructible barrels replication.
· Fixed a crash involving the steam sockets networking system.

· The bug "Unreal Engine is exiting due to D3D device being lost" it's a common error from games made with Unreal Engine. We have created a steam discussion with some guidelines on how to fix the problem: https://steamcommunity.com/app/910490/discussions/0/5673948479035084906/

[u]Major Issues[/u]

· Fixed a bug where some clients stayed in an infinite loading screen after finishing a contract.
· Fixed a bug at M.A.G.N.U.S boss fight that after 10 minutes, the enemies with the laser balls stop spawning.
· Fixed a bug at M.A.G.N.U.S boss fight that occurs after the party died in the boss fight. After respawning, some clients couldn't see the boss HP bar.
· Fixed a bug where some enemies in an ambush spawned outside the barriers, blocking the player from clearing the ambush.
· Fixed a bug where the "Lucky draw" skill from Troy was blocked after using it at close range. 
· Fixed a bug at "WASTELAND 7A", where the generation of the map sometimes had no route to the end of the contract.
· Fixed a bug at "WASTELAND 7A", where the player could get stuck with a collider.
· Fixed a bug at "Doors wide shut" contract, when the boss Alpha Gorus could get stuck at the stairs.
· Fixed a bug where the ready button might disapper in some clients.
· Fixed a bug with the GPU performance, even if the game was tabbed. Now the game is capped at 144FPS avoiding the GPU to reach its maximum capacity for no reason.
· Fixed a bug where starting a contract in a group, the game kept loading until a client was kicked out automatically.
· Fixed a bug at the "TROUBLE IN PARADISE" contract that could make the player fall from the map.
· Fixed a bug at the elevators from "KEMMEKH": Now the objects such as heal packs from Zero will follow the elevator while moving.
· Fixed a bug of "Queen Magoth's" that occur in the middle of the fight, deforming her 3D Model.
· Fixed a bug of the "Suriken Ricochet", that sometimes occurred in the second hit, not teleporting to the second target.
· Fixed a bug at "KNOCKIN' ON HEAVEN'S DOOR" contract where the mission's target didn't spawn, blocking players from completing the contract.
· Fixed a bug to players with high ping, where they could reach level ten without filling the XP bar.
· Fixed a bug where players's skills would enter in cooldown if those were interrupted during its casting animations.
· Fixed a bug with the "HEALING KIT" from Zero, where it was possible to consume the pickup without healing. 
· Fixed a bug at all contracts with cargo protection missions, where the AI of some enemies ignored the vehicle/cargo.
· Fixed a bug at all plague contracts with the "CURSE OF LAÁUME", where the three colored spheres did not move.
· Fixed a bug that might occur when killing some bosses they would fall under the map not completing the contract.
· Fixed a bug when the player enters a contract with a first person camera instead of the usual top-down third person camera

[u]Fixes[/u]:

· Fixed a bug with the "Hatch Guy's Very Special...'Soup'" quest. Now you should be able to finish it with one Nightbringer eye.
· Fixed a bug at "KEMMEKH", with render issues on the plagued area.
· Fixed a bug in the CODEX that didn't show some attack information for some enemies.
· Fixed a bug at the end contract view showing some items twice.
· Fixed a bug of the Trap Implosion skill that could render some particles in front of the camera.
· Fixed a bug that generated some plague segments at "THE PALACE OF PAIN" maps in normal mode.
· Fixed a bug that might occur when crossing some segments of a contract, rendering a white flash for one frame.
· Fixed a bug at some segments of SKUA maps that did not spawn enemies.
· Fixed a bug when loading an audio or dialogue at the start of a contract with one or two seconds lag.
· Fixed a bug at M.A.G.N.U.S's boss fight that vibrates when changing his state between attacking and idle.
· Fixed a bug at "Overprotection" contract after respawning at the Toxic fog area the voice line reproduced twice.
· Fixed a bug involving the roughness rendering of the enemies at WASTELAND 7A.
· Fixed a bug at the last Black Box cube, removing the sound from the dialogue. Now it will reproduce as it should.
· Fixed a bug when the party leader joined in the contract selection screen. When going back to the lobby, the "DISBAND PARTY" button wasn't visible.
· Fixed a bug with the equipments between vector 11 and 40, showing incorrect statistics from what you really get.
· Fixed a bug not showing the target's location at the contract, "KNOCKIN' ON HEAVEN'S DOOR".
· Fixed a bug where some enemies didn't show its death animations on some clients during a contract.
· Fixed a bug where the "LUCK OF THE DRAW" Skill from Troy, wouldn't be thrown if they had an object or wall behind them.
· Fixed a bug at the input settings, where they could block players from personalizing their controls. 
· Fixed a bug when completing a contract in multiplayer, it could block the inputs of switching characters.
· Fixed a bug where after using Troy's "Strong Shot" or "Execution" skills, the basic attack wouldn't cast automatically unless you trigger the attack input again.
· Fixed a bug at the Lobby regarding skins. If a player leaves the lobby and another took its place, it could mix both skins of both characters.
· Fixed a bug of the weapon "RED BARON" from Zero. When overheated, the particles kept in place in an additive way.
· Fixed a bug at "SHUT IT DOWN" contract, where Kosmo was able to jump on top of a terminal.
· Fixed a bug of the consumable "PORTABLE HEALTH STATION". The area was not visible for clients in a multiplayer game.
· Fixed a bug of the weapon "SOLAR EDGE" from Cass. The passive was only working for the host player of the game.
· Fixed a bug of the weapon "RACKAT'S BULWARK" from Kosmo. The passive was not reducing the damage while using "WHIRLWIND".
· Fixed a rendering issue at the CODEX, now the enemies will be rendered at good quality.
· Fixed a hole at the "HUNTED HUNTER" contract in plague mode at the boss fight.
· Fixed a localization bug regarding the Black Boxes dialogues.
· Fixed a localization bug at "KNOCKIN' ON HEAVEN'S DOOR" contract when delivering the battery spheres
· Fixed a localization bug in the skill tutorials.
· Fixed a localization error at the Colosseum. Changing "Where heroes ART born" to "Where heroes ARE born".
· Fixed a localization bug of the weapon "NAZDAROVJE" from Kosmo.  
· Fixed a localization bug of the weapon "DIES IRAE" from Zero.  
· Fixed the bug of the "Overprotection" contract, displaying the environment windows with a bright green color in the toxic fog segment.
· Fixed some localization bugs of some weapons.
· Fixed some localization bugs of tutorials.
· Fixed some localization bugs of some skill/upgrade descriptions.
· Fixed some collision errors at "THE AURORA RELOCATION" contract.
· Fixed some collision errors at "FOR THE UPRISING" contract.
· Fixed some holes at SKUA maps specially between doors and junctions.

[u]Others[/u]:

· Fixed the issue where Troy's "Luck of the draw" could be activated accidentally, after using Strong Shot. The sequence "Right click + Left click" has been improved.

[b]PS[/b]: [u]Please remember that the progress you've made in the beta isn't shared with the public version.[/u]


[h3]Bug reporting[/h3]
Killsquad is an Early Access game. As such, it is a product in development. Have encountered a bug? We are sorry. Please report it by joining our Discord community. Please do so here:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]https://discord.com/invite/killsquad[/url]

If your game crashes, a Crash reporter will appear. Please add the details of what you were doing at the time of the crash and send it to us. If you want to, feel free to contact us directly here at [b]killsquad@novarama.com[/b], with your "[u]Saved[/u]" folder ([u]C:\Users%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Killsquad[/u]) attached.


[h3]We need your help![/h3]
Do you like our game? Would you like to help an independent developer? Here is what you can do:

[b]Reviews![/b]
This is THE single most important thing you can do. Reviews do magic to the Steam algorithm. Or, if you wrote a negative review back in the day, and feel we’ve done a good job, do you know you can update your review? Reviews are the blood that keeps us alive!

[b]Social media follow:[/b]

Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]https://discord.com/invite/killsquad[/url]
Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/killsquadgame]https://twitter.com/killsquadgame[/url]
And on the Steam forums

[b]Streaming![/b]
Stream Killsquad, post videos on Youtube. Tell the world about it. If you have a significant following, contact us at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url], and we’ll try to support you in any way we can.

[b]Media[/b]
Are you a member of the media? We want to meet you! Contact us at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url]

[h3]About Killsquad[/h3]
Killsquad is an action-packed 4 player action RPG where sci-fi mercenaries raid planets seeking fame and glory. With four planets to explore, over thirty unique contracts to master, more than 100 weapons and 30 unique enemies, Killsquad offers an adrenaline-pumping journey into a dystopian future full of blood and black humour. Killsquad is now on Steam Early Access, with an approximate launch date of Summer 2021.

[h3]About Novarama[/h3]
Killsquad is developed by Novarama, a Barcelona-based independent games developer with +18 years of experience, 11 of them as a Sony exclusive studio. With a team of +40 people, Novarama's mission statement is to building innovative games for mass audiences. Killsquad is our first fully self-published game. Visit Novarama's website at [url=www.novarama.com]www.novarama.com[/url]
