[b]PSA[/b]: [u]Please remember that the progress you make in the beta, won't be shared with the public version. The public version will be available in a couple of days.

[b]PSA2:[/b] [u]Some of you might notice at the killsquad STEAM page some hidden Achievements. We are currently working on implementing them for the [b]next summer update[/b], so they are [b]not achievable[/b] right now even if they show up.[/u]

[/u]

notes.title: Killsquad CORE 2 Beta Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Killsquad Beta Core 2 Update v0.17.3_beta.10[/h1]

[b]PSA[/b]: [u]Please remember that the progress you make in the beta, won't be shared with the public version. The public version will be available in a couple of days.[/u]

To learn more about betas, please check the following FAQ:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/910490/discussions/0/3093383255707217200/

[hr][/hr]


The Core 2 Update is here! This patch comes with major changes. The skill and upgrade system has been reworked. Now, you can preview, buy, and equip from the skills menu to combine them in new and exciting ways. You will be able to explore these new features with the revamped UI, new interface, interactions and new functionalities such as shop rerolls or ways to save your preferred skill arrangements.

[b]PROGRESSION[/b]

In this update we have focused in reworking the core system of the character skills allowing full customization of your build using the new skill tree. Also, and maybe the more important change, your abilities are [b]automatically[/b] upgraded inside a contract using the upgrades and skills you preselected at the skill tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/1a7777f2db19a02cb698cbcada5296140dea9e1d.jpg[/img]

[u]TECS[/u]

A new unique currency is added to the game: TECS. They can be earned and found in contracts. Use these TECS to unlock Skills and Upgrades for a specific character in the Skill Tree. Look for them carefully as they exist in a specific amount for each character.

[u]Skills tree[/u]

Added a skill tree to each character, use TECS to unlock Skills and upgrades. Equip them and combine them in new and exciting ways to achieve the play style you like. You will need to buy at least one upgrade from one level to unlock the purchase of the next level, after that you can equip whatever you want even if they are all level ten upgrades. Fully customize your build!

[b]NOTE:[/b] Veteran players will get all the TECS rewarded by contracts after downloading the patch, but all the hidden TECS will need to be found.

[u]Builds and presets[/u]

Heroes have 10 cores that allows to assign skills and upgrades to their build. Each of them will have a cost, higher tiers will cost more than low tiered upgrades. Combine them in different ways to create the playstyle of your choice! Save the arrangements in one of the five available preset slots to switch between your skills and upgrades!

[b]SKILLS AND UPGRADES[/b]

With the new system we have taken the opportunity of balancing existing upgrades and adding new ones. Also, all descriptions have been overhauled to improve readability and give more information to the player.

· Kosmo has received a new upgrade: Turbo Whirlwind.
· Cass has received a new upgrade: Ultimate Hunter.
· Troy has received tree new upgrades: Karma Card, Last man standing and Sleight of Hand.
· Cass's In and Out upgrade has been removed from the game.
· Troy's Gotcha upgrade has been removed from the game.
· Troy's Dodge Master upgrade has been removed from the game.
· Troy's Dead Man Walking upgrade has been removed from the game.
· All descriptions have been updated giving more information on the skill/upgrade.
· Some skills and upgrades names have been changed.
· Some skills and upgrades received a numerical rebalance. [b][i]It's not a definitive number, and it may change[/i][/b]

[b]NOTE:[/b] This section is still in progress, it might change in the public release.

[b]UI[/b]

A new design comes to the game alongside major changes at quality of life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/19e023f7f290ea887ef615d49b764bfb1bc70fdd.jpg[/img]


[u]Shop[/u]

A new Reroll mechanic is added to the shop as a quality of life improvement. Now you can pay a little amount of credits to manually reroll the shop stock to look for your desired equipment, we hope this change will ease your grinding for the perfect piece of equipment. Also, as requested, we added a weapon and gear comparison.

[u]General Changes[/u]

· Added an icon to show how many TECS can be found in a contract and how many you already found there.
· Added a new message in the contract selector screen when the host of a game chooses a contract notifying all group members.
· Added new upgrade icons at the skill tree.
· Added an outline to all intractable items to give more feedback to the player.
· Added particle effects in the lobby when a player is ready.
· Added a new special TEC pickup. These items can only appear on contracts indicating it.
· Added new hover popup on currency sections as the lobby, shop and in contract game showing the important currencies for that section.
· Added a new start splash art at the begining of the game.
· Changed the color of the rebel faction from red to blue.
· Updated the UI at the lobby. New visuals before starting a contract improving the feedback to the player.
· Updated the UI at the heroes section. A Centralized section of all the statistics, inventory, character progression, cosmetics and vanity items for all characters.
· Updated the UI at the shop. A clearer interface able to show more information of an item alongside a new reroll system.
· Updated the UI at the player profile. Better view of your statistics, reputation levels and vanity badges/icons.
· Updated the UI at the contract selector. Easier to navigate between plague and normal mode and to select a contract to play.
· Updated the UI at the ESC menu inside a contract. New visuals showing current equipment and your selected upgrades ordered by level. You can keep track on your stats and when will new upgrades be available inside a contract.
· Added tutorial videos to preview all the skill and upgrades. You can also watch those videos in the ESC menu inside a contract.
· Updated all controls UI icons.
· Updated the items upgrade Icons. Three new status showing when the weapon/gear is updated, when you have enough resources for the upgrade and when the weapon can be upgraded but you don't have enough resources.

[b]REBALANCE[/b]

[u]Major overhauls[/u]

· The toxic fallout in "Overprotection" contract now launches a healing area inside the shields to help during the struggle.
· The palace of pain received more monster variation in enemy waves and also added more time to the hold area segment.
· Balanced some HUB segments at SKUA Maps by adding more enemies and pickups. They were empty before the rebalance.


[u]General overhauls[/u]

· Rebalanced all game Recruit and Veteran contracts, focusing on shorter and more fun games.
· Rebalanced all SKUA Enemies.
· Rebalanced all credit rewards after the [b]second[/b] time you play a Recruit contract.

[b]AUDIO[/b]

· Troy received a SFX rework for his guns, with more than 30 new gun SFX.
· Zero received a SFX rework for his laser gun, with more than 10 new gun SFX.
· General Overhaul to the ambient sounds at SKUA maps, adding more than 25 new SFX.
· Added sound feedback to UI.
· Added sound feedback to the Steerable Ball skill.
· Added sound feedback to the Mass Execution skill.
· Added sound feedback to the Emergency Shield skill.
· Added footsteps sound to all SKUA floor types.
· Added footsteps sound to all THE PALACE OF PAIN floor types.
· Added footsteps sound to all WASTELAND 7A floor types.
· Added missing audio in the Queen Maggoth's boss cinematic entrance.
· Reduced the volume of the starting music at the coliseum.

[b]GENERAL[/b]

· Updated the particles when destroying a SKUA ball in an area.
· Changed the color of Kosmo's Berserker Taunt skill. 
· Added a new death SFX to the S.K.Y.F.E.D BOSS.
· Added a new SFX in the Toxic area of the Overprotection contract. 
· Added new particles to the barriers of the Overprotection contract.
· Added four new entrance animations to each hero at the start of a contract.
· Added destructible rocks to WASTELAND 7A maps 
· Added a new dash animation for Lilith.
· Added a new dash animation for Zero.
· Modified the dash animation for Kosmo.
· General review to all "WASTELAND 7A" maps fixing holes or collisions.
· Added a fire spark particle to SKUA maps.



[b]BUG FIXING[/b]

[u]Crashes[/u]:

· Fixed a crash that might occur to hosts after selecting a skill with ZERO.
· Fixed a crash that might occur after a group dissolves and a client tried to play a contract in single player afterwards.

· The bug "Unreal Engine is exiting due to D3D device being lost" it's a common error from games made with Unreal Engine. We have created a steam discussion with some guidelines on how to fix the problem: https://steamcommunity.com/app/910490/discussions/0/5673948479035084906/

[u]Major Issues[/u]

· Fixed a bug where some clients stayed in an infinite loading screen after finishing a contract.
· Fixed a bug at M.A.G.N.U.S boss fight that after 10 minutes, the enemies with the laser balls stop spawning.
· Fixed a bug at M.A.G.N.U.S boss fight that ocurrs after the party died in the boss fight. After respawning some clients couldn't see the boss HP bar.
· Fixed a bug where some enemies in an ambush spawned outside the barriers blocking the player from clearing the ambush.
· Fixed a bug where the "Lucky draw" skill from Troy was blocked after using it at close range. 
· Fixed a bug at "WASTELAND 7A", where the generation of the map sometimes had no route to the end of the contract.
· Fixed a bug at "WASTELAND 7A", where the player could get stuck with a collider.
· Fixed a bug at "Doors wide shut" contract, when the boss Alpha Gorus could get stuck at the stairs.

notes.title: SKUA Update Out Now!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the release our our newest update: Skua, available now!

[previewyoutube=wGf4ci0Czgg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]It's a new world...[/h3]

With Skua, we deliver our fifth game world to the Killsquad universe. After visiting Wasteland07, Kemmekh, the Palace of Pain and the Colosseum of the Unseen, you're going in against your toughest challenge yet: Skua, the orbital space station of the Federation. Their training ground for new weapons and battle tactics. 

Skua brings a full new storyline to Killsquad: expect new locations, all-new enemies and bosses, and new contracts for you to take. And yes, there's also new quests, cosmetics for you to show off your skill, new victory animations... well, you get the idea. Go Play!

[h3]Performance[/h3]

The Skua update also brings our biggest-ever quality of life boost: we have been hard at work to raise performance across all hardware configurations, so you can expect higher frame rates, more fluid gameplay, and an overall smoother experience. We have also been stamping out bugs like there's no tomorrow. As we advance in our Early Access, we want to give you guys the best experience, and we feel Skua is a huge leap forward.

So, whether it's for the all-new adventures, or to rediscover the game with the new performance boost, jump in! There's a universe waiting for you.

[h3]Full patch notes[/h3]
Follow [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/910490/discussions/0/3071991790344127015/]this link[/url] to read our full patch notes for the Skua update. 


[h3]Language support[/h3]
SKUA is available in English, Spanish, Italian, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Korean & Japanese. 

[h3]Roadmap[/h3]
We plan to update our roadmap next week, to announce all the exciting stuff coming to Killsquad after Skua. So yes, stand by. We have more cool stuff coming. New hero? Yep. New progression system? Check. Cinematics? Yessir!

[h3]Bug reporting[/h3]
Killsquad is an Early Access game. As such, it is a product in development. Have encountered a bug? We are sorry. Please report it by joining our Discord community. Please do so here:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]https://discord.com/invite/killsquad[/url]

You can report bugs on the #beta-bug-report channel. Please be specific describing the bug: the easier for us to trigger the bug, the faster we solve it. If you don’t like Discord, do get in touch directly at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url] with the bug info.


[h3]We need your help![/h3]
Do you like our game? Would you like to help an independent developer? Here is what you can do:

[h3]Reviews![/h3]
This is THE single most important thing you can do. Reviews do magic to the Steam algorithm. Or, if you wrote a negative review back in the day, and feel we’ve done a good job, do you know you can update your review? Reviews are the blood that keeps us alive!

[h3]Social media follow:[/h3]

Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]https://discord.com/invite/killsquad[/url]
Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/killsquadgame]https://twitter.com/killsquadgame[/url]
And on the Steam forums

[h3]Streaming![/h3]
Stream Killsquad, post videos on Youtube. Tell the world about it. If you have a significant following, contact us at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url], and we’ll try to support you in any way we can.

[h3]Media[/h3]
Are you a member of the media? We want to meet you! Contact us at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url]

[h3]About Killsquad[/h3]
Killsquad is an action-packed 4 player action RPG where sci-fi mercenaries raid planets seeking fame and glory. With four planets to explore, over thirty unique contracts to master, more than 100 weapons and 30 unique enemies, Killsquad offers an adrenaline-pumping journey into a dystopian future full of blood and black humour. Killsquad is now on Steam Early Access, with an approximate launch date of Summer 2021.

[h3]About Novarama[/h3]
Killsquad is developed by Novarama, a Barcelona-based independent games developer with +18 years of experience, 11 of them as a Sony exclusive studio. With a team of +40 people, Novarama's mission statement is to building innovative games for mass audiences. Killsquad is our first fully self-published game. Visit Novarama's website at [url=www.novarama.com]www.novarama.com[/url]

notes.content:
Hello, Bounty Hunters!

After a long pause, we're back to the Dev Diary! And we have a really good reason to do so: today, we launch the Beta of our next major Killsquad update, Skua. This new update will bring two huge features: the full Skua Campaign, and a much-desired Performance Upgrade.

Skua is the fifth game world in the Killsquad universe, after Wasteland 07, Kemmekh, the Palace of Pain and the Colosseum. Skua is a huge orbital space station owned by the Federation. They use it to store and test their newest weapons of destruction. And guess who is going in? Yes, correct: YOU. The Skua campaign brings a huge amount of content to KILLSQUAD: new locations, all new enemies, new contracts, new storylines... it's a whole new world for you guys to explore. To suffer. To conquer.

Now, our second major point today is performance. You guys care about performance. And so do we at Novarama. And now it's even more important: with our success in Asia (our friends in China and Korea, yes, this means you!) we've realized a lot of people play Killsquad in net cafés. So, we worked super hard to give you a super smooth experience, across *any* machine. So yes, all of you are getting higher frame-rates. More stability. A better experience for all our community. We hope you enjoy it. 

I don't want to drag on for too long. Today is a day to play and celebrate. If you want a final experience, wait for a few more days while we sort out the remaining bugs. notes.title: Dev Diary: Roadmap update!
notes.content:
Hello all!
After Christmas, we took some weeks off the Dev Diary routine to chart our roadmap for Killsquad. With that process now done, we’re ready to begin telling you what we are working on. Here we go!

[h3]Optimization & Asia[/h3]
We have received comments that Killsquad’s framerate is lower than it should: framerate drops, difficulty running the game in some hardware… this is especially true for our fans in Asia (Korea and China mostly). Many of you are playing Killsquad in Net-Cafés, which we love. But sometimes the framerate is low. So, we have one team optimizing the game for performance. You’ve seen some of this already on the recent Hotfix, but more is coming on the next major update. Expect a more fluid experience across all machines. This has the side benefit of helping a console version as well (more on this later!)

[h3]Crashes, bugs, stability[/h3]
In 2020, we had a game we needed to fix: there were systems still to be implemented or missing, so our focus was on the gameplay. Sales during Christimas 2020 have proven Killsquad is becoming a pretty good game. But that has introduced many bugs. We have a second team just focused on crashes, bugs, etc. Again, you saw some of their work on the Hotfix last week, but expect a push to polish the game so there’s no bugs at all.

[h3]Usability & UI[/h3]
Killsquad’s interface has been steadily growing as more systems were added: gadgets, talismans, portraits, cosmetics, quests… as a consequence of that, let’s say the interface is nowhere as logical or intuitive as it should be: some sections are out of place, some are hard to find. So, we are working on a full UI revision, to make sure things are as intuitive as possible. We’ll promote some sections, remove old ones, and make sure the interface works for you, not against you.

[h3]Skua[/h3]
The three points above are all about Quality of Life. And Quality of Life is super important. But so is content. So, we confirm on the next update you are getting Skua, a full new world with its own contracts, quests and enemies. Skua is the space station where the Feds build and train their army of robots, so it can move across the galaxy conquering rogue planets. Expect Skua to drop during spring, in a mega-update that will include also all of the other things mentioned above. 

[h3]Playstation? Yes! Playstation[/h3]
We are working on Killsquad for Playstation. There, we said it. Expect it to drop summer this year, both on Ps4 and Ps5. We have always loved this kind of A-RPG on console, from Helldivers to Gauntlet to Alien Nation, and we wanted to be there. The port is almost done, we just need to optimize it and rework some network systems. But yes, Killsquad is coming to console. There’s no plans for other consoles outside of Playstation that we can confirm at this point.

[h3]And more![/h3]
And that’s not all. We’re working on an opening cinematic. We’re seriously thinking about progression changes to make the game more fun for longer. We’re working on new cosmetics. We have a lot of things we want to share with you all. 2021 is gonna be a great year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/5804d58ca9ae322752d0e0d74badc591e60c2fb7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dev Diary: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
We hope you guys had a blast these holidays, and got to spend some time with friends and family. We are happy to see many of you chose Killsquad as your end-of-Year companion! We saw a nice boost in sales, so THANK YOU. Because of you, Killsquad is now on the verge of crossing the 100.000 copies sold mark, not bad at all considering we're still in Early Access. We're happy. And, if we made your holidays more enjoyable, what else could we expect?

Now, back to work! As you know, being in Early Access, and work never stops. Every Friday, around 6 PM CET, we will bring you our Developer Diary, with fresh news straight from the dev team.

This week I am going to share some sneak peek, early clips of Skua, our next world. Skua is an orbital space station, where the Federation does robot R+D. Not that the Federation cares about killing human soldiers. You've met (and killed them) already. Skua was all about a Federation-wide effort to cut costs. Why send the children of the Federation to fight against the Killsquad, when you can mass-produce an army of robotic soldiers? 

So, expect to enter a giant space factory / warehouse / robotic R+D facility. And expect to explore new locations, meet new foes, semibosses, contracts... Skua will drop in our next major update, due in Spring. But for now, here's a first look at the environment. It's still unlit, but it's slowly building up inside Unreal Engine:

[previewyoutube=6HfdSCA-qzg;full][/previewyoutube]

Skua comes with its own set of enemies and tactics. So for example, check out this healing robot. Whenever a team-mate falls, he'll scramble to the rescue with electro-shock. So, make sure you take these guys down first, or they will regen fallen team mates to cause endless trouble:

[previewyoutube=VH9KKzBX5KU;full][/previewyoutube]

Skua also is all about ambush and surprise. We're working on some cool new ways to make enemies appear. Here's a very early clip of what we are working on, we hope you like it:

[previewyoutube=QqWXUUvusQw;full][/previewyoutube]

Last, but not least, we'd like to confirm we are working on a Hotfix, due shortly. To everyone posting bugs on Steam/Discord/reviews: we are listening, and working on them. In the short, short term, you should receive:

- A fix to the "game is too dark" issue
- A fix to the "Zero's traps kill FPS", especifically the Trap Implosion & Wave Trap.
- Some bugs on some Quests that don't fulfill when they should.

The next months are going to see us devoting a LOT of time to bug fixing, as we want to slowly stabilize the game to give you the best experience. 

So there is a ton of work ahead, but we're back. Expect news every Friday, as our next update takes shape. Meanwhile, remember you can always reach us on Steam discussion forums or, if you prefer that, in our official [url=https://discord.gg/xCsHatstdQ]Discord Server[/url]

See you guys! Thank you for playing Killsquad!

notes.title: Killsquad’s Christmas update, launches today
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=okvZfve6YzM;full][previewyoutube=tSGJ6TsbPWU;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

It's Christmas time! And Killsquad is in a festive mood! Come play our themed update, full of season's goodies!

[h3]Our Christmas Event![/h3]
Get ready for a Christmas extravaganza that has taken over the game lobby, and offers all-new, thematic quests with unique seasonal rewards!

[h3]Cosmetics! [/h3]
You guys have been asking for costumes and cosmetics for a long time. And Santa is here, bringing plenty of items to dress your heroes up! These are tied to the new Quests, so you'll need to work hard to find and acquire them!

[h3]Talismans[/h3]
Talismans are arcane objects of power that give permanent benefits to the wearer. They can be found across contracts, or on the Colosseum. To unleash their power, you'll need to find their pieces, assemble them, and power them up. 

[h3]Emotes[/h3]
We all have a goofy side. With the new emote system, showing yours is easier than ever. Communicate with your team, lead the way, or just say hi! The decision is all yours.

[h3]Skill & Upgrade review[/h3]
We have spent a good amount of time fixing the heroes' skill tree & weapon upgrades, to make your decisions more meaningful and interesting. 

[h3]New weather patterns[/h3]
You're gonna see better snow, rain and whatnot, as our team of artists and programmers make Unreal Engine shine. 

[h3]New soundtrack[/h3]
We have revamped Killsquad's soundtrack, with +30 all new music tracks to fit different missions, moods and planets. We hope you like it!

[h3]Bug reporting[/h3]
Killsquad is an Early Access game. As such, it is a product in development. Have encountered a bug? We are sorry. Please report it by joining our Discord community. Please do so here:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]https://discord.com/invite/killsquad
[/url]

You can report bugs on the #beta-bug-report channel. Please be specific describing the bug: the easier for us to trigger the bug, the faster we solve it. If you don’t like Discord, do get in touch directly at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url] with the bug info.


[h3]We need your help!
[/h3]
Do you like our game? Would you like to help an independent developer? Here is what you can do:

[b]Reviews![/b]
Please write a review. This is THE single most important thing you can do. Reviews do magic to the Steam algorithm. Or, if you wrote a negative review back in the day, and feel we’ve done a good job, do you know you can update your review? Reviews are the blood that keeps us alive!

[b]Social media follow:
[/b]
Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]https://discord.com/invite/killsquad[/url]
Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/killsquadgame]https://twitter.com/killsquadgame[/url]
And on the Steam forums

[b]Streaming![/b]
Stream Killsquad, post videos on Youtube. Tell the world about it. If you have a significant following, contact us at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url], and we’ll try to support you in any way we can.

[b]Media[/b]
Are you a member of the media? We want to meet you! Contact us at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url]



[h3]Full Patch Notes[/h3]

[b]Killsquad Xmas update 0.15.3.6[/b]
PSA: Please remember that the progress you've made in the beta isn't shared with the public version.

Xmas is here! This update brings Cosmetics, Talismans, a new Soundtrack, Vanity Animations, Quests, and more! But first and foremost...

[b]Cass:[/b]
· Fixed the bug where players couldn't attack as Cass after using its Shuriken Skill.

This issue has been addressed. Thank you everyone for your reports.

[b]Xmas event and Quests:[/b]
Find Presents that are scattered around the planets and decorate your Main Lobby menu by completing the quests.

· Added Christmas-themed decorations in the lobby menu.
· Added Christmas gifts in Contracts.
· Added "A Very Lethal Christmas!" Quest. Completing this quest will give rewards and decorate the Lobby menu.
· Added 12 Quests for Veteran and Spec Ops Contracts.
· Added 12 Hero Quests.

[b]Talismans:[/b]
Find and gather Talisman fragments to complete one. You can equip these forbidden objects of the Unseen to level it and up to unlock its full potential and remove its negative status.

· Added Talismans in the game. These objects are permanent unlockable items that can be equipped and leveled up. 
· Talismans fragments can be found in Colosseum Contracts or in Unseen chests in Contracts near Colosseum ones. 
· Added 16 new Talismans.
· Added Colosseum Fragments.
· Added Contract Fragments.

[b]UI:[/b]
-Hero:

· Updated Hero's selection screen.
· Updated the equipment and stats sections to make it more compact.

-Inventory:

· Added Talisman tab in the Inventory. Unlock it once you find a Talisman Fragment.
· Added Talisman Equipment sections in the Inventory.
· Added quick switch between heroes in the Hero and Inventory screen, with the RMB, "Y" with the Xbox Controller and "△" with the DualShock Controller.
· Updated Skin's sections to include Cosmetics.

[b]Cosmetics:[/b]
In this update, you will be able to add cosmetics in your Heroes. These are unlockable and permanent items.

· Character models have been prepared to be able to wear cosmetics.
· Added the first wave of Cosmetics, 36 in total. 4 of them being obtainable only during Christmas Quest events.
· Added body sections in the Skin section of Hero's selection screen: Head, Arms, Legs and Body.

More cosmetics and Body part ones will come in future updates.

[b]Music:[/b]
· Added over +30 new music tracks.

[b]Vanity Animations:[/b]
Players will be able to cast an emote inside Contracts by holding the "C" key, or pressing twice the L3 joystick with the controller.

· Added 4 Emotes on each Hero.
· More will be added in future updates.

[b]Crashes:[/b]
· Fixed a couple of random crashes gathered with the Crash Reporter. Thank you for sending us your crashes.
· Fixed the bug where the game would crash with some users as soon as it's launched.
· Fixed the bug where the game could crash related with switching tabs.

[b]General:[/b]
PSA: Updated the least popular skill upgrades on each Hero. We encourage people to check and try out their abilities.

· Replaced Troy's "Focus" mechanic with the "Luck of the Draw".
· Enemies will now launch upwards in the air, instead of away from the player, with Kosmos' "Stomp" and Cass' "Dimensional Tear".
· Colosseum Contracts will always drop remaining Colosseum Fragments to complete a Talisman, but some will only appear in Recruit or Spec Ops.
· Faction Experience is now visible as a reward from quests and chests in contracts.
· Added new animations on existing and new skill upgrades.
· Added Unseen Chests. These can give players Talisman fragments or Unseen Trinkets.
· Added Talisman EXP orbs. These can appear when you have a talisman equipped and level them up.
· Added Weather particle effects: Rain and Snow.
· Added more translations in every supported language.
· Added Portuguese Community Translations. Thank you Mazter for your contributions.
· Added visual feedback on Kosmo's upgrade, "Emergency Shield", to display an icon near the mini-map.
· Added dmg buff % after a crit stat in Troy's "Cognita Finem", Cass' "King of Spades" and Zero's "Stinger".
· Removed the extra crit stat in Troy's "Cognita Finem", Cass' "King of Spades" and Zero's "Stinger".
· Removed Zero's buff damage passive every time he dodged. Instead, that extra damage is distributed to his other skill upgrades.
· Removed "Recommended Elements" in the Colosseum Contract description.
· Updated Credits.
· Updated descriptions and icons on some Skills.
· Updated the scroll in the Quests menu to have a higher sensitivity.
· Updated the Recruit Colosseum Contract to appear as an optional Contract.
· Updated the text of the descriptions in Colosseum Contracts (Thank you tehgreg!).
· Updated Recruit Colosseum's item Max Vector rewards (weapons & gear) from 50, to 80.
· Updated Cass' Decay skill to last 1 second longer.
· Fixed the issue where players could fall through the map in the Recruit Contract, "Doors wide shut".
· Fixed the issue where players could fall through the map in the Veteran Contract, "Arachnophilia?".
· Fixed the issue where players could get knockbacked over the elevator found in Double Trouble's Contract and fall through the map.
· Fixed the issue where players could get stuck with Kemmekh's elevators.
· Fixed the issue where players would suddenly stop running after skipping the dialogs by spamming the B or O button with the controllers.
· Fixed some emissive and vfx materials being too bright after Core Update's rendering changes.
· Fixed the bug where the upgrade "BETTER WEAPONS IN BLACK MARKET" could still appear in the gear "KORMOS-4994" (Thank you "Hissatsu").
· Fixed the bug where the "Upgrade Available F1" UI to show the text on its correct size in every supported language.
· Fixed the bug where the text at the rewards screen wouldn't appear on its correct size in every supported language.
· Fixed tutorial splash screens to appear on its correct size in every supported language.
· Fixed the bug where the anti-ranged protection barrier on the "Executor" Gen 2 enemy could appear invisible.
· Fixed the bug where players couldn't teleport with Cass' Shuriken in the middle of an attack (Thank you Qoinz!).
· Fixed the bug where players couldn't Phase Shift in the middle of an attack as Cass (Thank you Qoinz!).
· Fixed the bug which incorrect stats appeared in some weapons.
· Fixed the bug where Troy's "Strong Shot" skill could trigger incorrect timing with its basic attack.
· Fixed the bug where Kosmo's, Cass' and Zero's materials didn't render transparencies.
· Fixed the bug where the Quests didn't properly update after switching tabs.
· Fixed the bug where on the Quests menu, the scroll bar didn't work smoothly when using it with the mouse.
· Fixed Troy's and Kosmo's character descriptions (Thank you Alexis & friends!).
· Fixed the bug where in the last objective of the Jade extraction mission, enemy "Jotuns" could get stuck in some areas (Thank you Alexis & friends!).
· Fixed the bug where Cass could mark enemies without unlocking the Skill upgrade, "Phased Thrust".
· Fixed the bug where Zero's "Damage Area" skill wouldn't disappear when taken the health kit.
· Fixed the bug where players who weren't the host, couldn't see the warning decals of the explosion curse.
· Fixed the animation of Troy's transitions with the "Execution" and "Death Warrant" skills.
· Fixed the bug where the mission objective ui could obscure other ui elements.
· Fixed the bug where 3D rendered elements in the Shop, wouldn't update after switching tabs.
· Fixed the bug where after hosting a private, if the player leaves, it won't be able to create a public match or join a contract. 
· Fixed the bug where Kosmos' "Sokol-ks" (the blue one) skin could appear as the default white "Orlan-Vt".
· Fixed the bug where Quests' UI could appear with the incorrect background.
· Fixed the bug where the 3D renders in the Rewards screen, disappeared after successfully loading the Lobby in the background.
· Fixed the bug where the reward pop up would not appear in some Veteran Quests.
· Fixed the bug where Zero's upgrade, "Force Lightning" would not shoot in some situations the direction you were aiming with a controller (Thank you Paul for your reports!).
· Fixed the bug where scrolling in a Quest description would scroll the background menu.
· Fixed the bug where some Quests appear with the check-box marked without completing its objectives.
· Fixed the bug where bought skins from Halloween would still appear in the Shop.
· Fixed the bug where players could equip weapons and gears from other Heroes.
· Fixed the bug where the message "You are below the recommended Vector" didn't update properly when switching Heroes / equipments.
· Fixed the bug where the "Consortium" and "Unseen" factions could display the wrong level.
· Fixed the bug where players could remove the blurred background in the "Skills" tab.
· Fixed the bug where heroes' model could not appear in the rewards screen. 
· Fixed the bug where heroes could appear in the rewards screen without its correct animations.
· Fixed the bug where heroes could appear in the rewards screen without its weapons.
· Fixed the bug where on the Inventory screen, the Vector displayed would be from the previous selected Hero.
· Fixed the bug where players wouldn't be able to attack as Cass if they didn't release the attack button after casting the Shuriken skill.
· Fixed the bug where weapons and gears from the range of Vectors 5 to 10 could display stats from Vector 70+ equipment.
· Fixed the bug where players could switch tabs on the lobby menu in the rewards screen.
· Fixed the bug where some Quests could appear without any animation feedback.
· Updated localization files.

[b]What are we doing right now:[/b]
We want to thank you again for your support during this year. Merry Christmas and happy new year!

· Working on the next big update, Skua.
· Celebrating Christmas.
· If your game crashes, a Crash reporter will appear. Please add the details of what you were doing at the time of the crash and send it to us. If you want to, feel free to contact us directly here at killsquad@novarama.com, with your "Saved" folder (C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\Local\\Killsquad) attached.

notes.content:
[h2]Killsquad Xmas Beta update 0.15.2.5[/h2]

If all goes well, this is our third and final Beta before our Christmas update. Expect the public update to drop late this week/early next week. This Beta rebalances the Colosseum and does general bug fixing on issues reported by the community. 

[h3]General[/h3]

· We have implemented a fixed vector difficulty on both the Recruit and the Spec Ops. Colosseum. This implements a CORE-style progression on Colosseums. We want to revisit the Colosseum after Christmas (to do procedural waves, re-think some gameplay rules, etc.) but for the time being we feel it's more fun to play in a static vector than a dynamic one (thanks for the discussions Bum, tehgreg, Dism, DeahTroy & Hissatsu!)
· Added visual feedback on Kosmo's upgrade, "Emergency Shield", to display an icon near the mini-map.
· Updated the scroll in the Quests menu to have a higher sensitivity.
· Updated the description of Zero's skill, "Wave Trap", where it didn't mention that would release two waves.
· Updated the previously fixed bug of the Quest where you have to complete the Colosseum Contract in less than 26 minutes and updated the description from "Veteran" to "Spec Ops."
· Fixed the bug where the reward pop up would not appear in some Veteran Quests.
· Fixed the bug where Zero's upgrade, "Force Lightning" would not shoot in some situations the direction you were aiming with a controller (Thank you Paul for your reports!).
· Fixed the bug where scrolling in a Quest description would scroll the background menu.
· Fixed the bug where some Quests appear with the checkbox marked without completing its objectives.
· Fixed the bug where bought skins from Halloween would still appear in the Shop.
· Fixed the bug where players could equip weapons and gears from other Heroes.
· Fixed the bug where the message "You are below the recommended Vector" didn't update properly when switching Heroes / equipments.
· Fixed the bug where the "Consortium" and "Unseen" factions could display the wrong level.
· Fixed the bug where players could remove the blurred background in the "Skills" tab.
· Fixed the bug where heroes' model could not appear in the rewards screen. 
· Fixed the bug where in the rewards screen, the 3D model of the reward could not appear.
· Fixed the bug where heroes could appear in the rewards screen without its correct animations.
· Fixed the bug where heroes could appear in the rewards screen without its weapons.
· Fixed the bug where on the Inventory screen, the Vector displayed would be from the previous selected Hero.
· Fixed the bug where players wouldn't be able to attack as Cass if they didn't release the attack button after casting the Shuriken skill.
· Fixed the bug where weapons and gears from the range of Vectors 5 - 10, could display in some occasions stats from 70+ ones.
· Fixed the bug where players could switch tabs on the lobby menu in the rewards screen.
· Fixed the bug where some Quests could appear without any animation feedback.
· Updated localization files.

[h3]What are we doing right now[/h3]
· Bug fixing.
· If your game crashes, a Crash reporter will appear. Please add the details of what you were doing at the time of the crash and send it to us. If you want to, feel free to contact us directly here at killsquad@novarama.com, with your "Saved" folder (C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\Local\\Killsquad) attached.

notes.title: Christmas Update Beta 2 - Out Now
notes.content:
Today we give you Beta 2 of our Christmas update! Let's cut to the chase, shall we?

[h3]What's a Beta?[/h3]
A Beta is the first release of our next update. We release it to do final testing and gather feedback. So enter if you like to enjoy the earliest version, but stay away if you'd prefer a fully tested, stable release. This version will be in Beta for the next week or so, depending on the Bugs we find. 

[h3]How do I join the Beta?[/h3]
Easy, join our [url=discord.gg/killsquad]Discord here[/url], and join the #beta-instructions channel

[h3]I hate Discord! How do I join Beta?[/h3]
Right click on Killsquad, and then:

Properties > Betas > Enter the next code m9XVbZvCRv3bwxeF > Check Code

[h3]How do I report bugs?[/h3]
Please report bugs at #beta-bug-report.

[h3]How do I report bugs, non-Discord version?[/h3]
Please email them to [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url]. 

[h2]Killsquad Xmas Beta update 0.15.1.3[/h2]

[h3]Crashes:[/h3]

· Fixed a couple of random crashes gathered with the Crash Reporter. Thank you for sending us your crashes.
· Fixed the bug where the game would crash with some users as soon as it's launched.
· Fixed the bug where the game could crash related with switching tabs.

[h3]General:[/h3]
· Adjusted the Colosseum's dynamic vector to fine-tune the difficulty (Thank you Bum)
· Adjusted the maximum resistance factor of enemies to different attack elements from 75 to 40 percent (Thank you Bum)
· Updated the Recruit Colosseum Contract to appear as an optional Contract. (Thank you Bum, thegreg!)
· Removed "Recommended Elements" in the Colosseum Contract description (Thank you thegreg!)
· Players can now switch weapons right before finishing an animation.
· Players can now cast another Skill right before finishing an animation.
· Added Faction Experience to chests in contracts and quests.
· Fixed the bug where players couldn't teleport with Cass' Shuriken in the middle of an attack (Thank you Qoinz!).
· Fixed the bug where players couldn't Phase Shift in the middle of an attack as Cass (Thank you Qoinz!).
· Fixed the issue where players couldn't cast Gadgets items in the middle of an animation. If the player is running or idle, a casting animation will appear.
· Updated Recruit Colosseum's item Max Vector rewards (weapons & gear) from 50, to 80.
· Updated the text of the descriptions in Colosseum Contracts (Thank you tehgreg!).
· Fixed the bug where enemies wouldn't drop Talisman EXP if players had much higher Vector than the Contract they were playing in (Thank you tehgreg!).
· Fixed the bug where Troy's Ultimate could cast without any cooldown (Thank you thegreg!).
· Fixed the bug where the UI Stats in the Heroes tab didn't display the sum of the values (Thank you tehgreg!).
· Fixed the bug where Troy's "Experienced Clones" skill didn't trigger its cooldown timer with players who weren't the host.
· Fixed the bug where Gadgets items in the shop would cost 0 credits (Thank you tehgreg!).
· Fixed the bug where Troy could launch infinitely his Lucky Cards without any cooldown.
· Fixed the bug where incorrect elements appeared in the Factions screen (Thank you tehgreg!).
· Fixed the bug where empty Contracts could appear with the Ping and the Join button.
· Fixed the bug which incorrect stats appeared in some weapons.
· Fixed "Improve your Charisma" Quests, now giving correct feedback of all the rewards they give. (Thank you tehreg!)
· Fixed the bug where Troy's "Strong Shot" skill could trigger incorrect timing with its basic attack.
· Fixed the bug where the Quest of finishing the Colosseum in less than 26 minutes wouldn't complete after beating its objective (Thank you Dism!)
· Fixed the bug where the UI of the remaining Waves of the Colosseum would appear in the same position as the Talisman EXP (Thank you tehgreg!).
· Fixed the bug where Kosmo's, Cass' and Zero's materials didn't render transparencies.
· Fixed the bug where default cosmetics didn't properly change after selecting some skins.
· Fixed the bug where the Quests didn't properly update after switching tabs.
· Fixed the bug where the bought items in the Shop didn't disappear (Thank you tehgreg!).
· Fixed the bug where on the Quests menu, the scroll bar didn't work smoothly when using it with the mouse.
· Fixed the bug where in the Quest "The Plague is coming", the first step couldn't be completed.
· Fixed Troy's and Kosmo's character descriptions (Thank you Alexis & friends!).
· Fixed the bug where in the last objective of the Jade extraction mission, Jotuns could get stuck in some areas (Thank you Alexis & friends!).
· Fixed the descriptions of the cooldown Talisman (Thank you Petrisis).
· Fixed the bug where Troy wouldn't be able to launch any more Cards if knockbacked during his throw animation.
· Fixed the bug where Cass could mark enemies without unlocking the Skill upgrade, "Phased Thrust".
· Fixed the bug where Zero's "Damage Area" skill wouldn't disappear when taken the health kit.
· Fixed the text where it stated that Zero could still have a damage boost after dodging.
· Fixed animation Troy's transitions with the "Execution" and "Death Warrant" skills.
· Fixed the bug where the images of the Contracts would float in the corner of the screen after zooming in/out.
· Fixed the bug where the enemy Mamluks wouldn't attack players.
· Fixed the bug where the mission objective ui could obscure other ui elements.
· Fixed the bug where 3D rendered elements in the Shop, wouldn't update after switching tabs.
· Fixed the bug where after hosting a private, if the player leaves, it won't be able to create a public match or join a contract.
· Fixed the bug where Kosmos' "Sokol-ks" (the blue one) skin could appear as the default white "Orlan-Vt".
· Fixed the bug where Quests' UI could appear with the incorrect background.
· Fixed the bug where the 3D renders in the Rewards screen, disappeared after successfully loading the Lobby in the background.
· Fixed the issue where players could fall through the map in the Recruit Contract, "Doors wide shut".
· Fixed the issue where players could fall through the map in the Veteran Contract, "Arachnophilia?".
· Fixed the issue where players could get stuck with Kemmekh's elevators.
· Fixed the issue where players could get knockbacked over the elevator in Double Trouble's Contract.
· Updated Portuguese with Community Translations. Thank you Mazter for your contributions.
· Updated localization files.

What are we doing right now:

· Bug fixing.
· If your game crashes, a Crash reporter will appear. Please add the details of what you were doing at the time of the crash and send it to us. If you want to, feel free to contact us directly here at killsquad@novarama.com, with your "Saved" folder (C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\Local\\Killsquad) attached.

notes.title: Killsquad Christmas Update Beta - Available Now
notes.content:
[h1]Surprise!!!![/h1]

Yep, the Beta of our next update drops... today. Why? Because we love you. And because you made our Black Friday amazing, and because lots of people sent us love in the form of reviews (please keep them coming, they are invaluable for our visibility). 

Killsquad is slowly evolving to the 10-ton-monster we always dreamt he would become. So it's time to give you guys some of our love back. Let's cut to the chase, we've got a game to play!

[h3]What's a Beta? Who are you? Why are you inside my computer?[/h3]
A Beta is the first release of our next update. We release it to do final testing and gather feedback. So enter if you like to enjoy the earliest version, but stay away if you'd prefer a fully tested, stable release. This version will be in Beta for the next 1-3 weeks, depending on the Bugs we find. 

[h3]How do I join the Beta?[/h3]
Easy, join our [url=discord.gg/killsquad]Discord here[/url], and join the #beta-instructions channel

[h3]But I hate Discord! How do I join Beta?[/h3]
Oh my god, you guys are so... Ok, here are some handy Beta instructions for you Discord-hating crowd:
Right click on Killsquad, and then:

Properties > Betas > Enter the next code m9XVbZvCRv3bwxeF > Check Code

[h3]But I don't own Killsquad! How do I join Beta?[/h3]
Buy Killsquad and support indies, please. Then join Beta. you'll make the world a better place!

[h3]Ok, I got it, how do I report bugs?[/h3]
Remember said Discord? Please report them pesky bugs at #beta-bug-report.

[h3]But remember I hate Discord! How do I report bugs?[/h3]
Grrrr... Ok, fine. Please email them to [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url]. 

[h3]Gotcha. What's in the Beta?[/h3]
Oh, [b]NOW [/b]we're talking. Enter our awesome Patch Notes, thanks to Jmen, our QA Lead! 
Drum Roll Please!

[h2]Killsquad Xmas update 0.15.0.14 BETA[/h2]

PSA: Please remember that you won't be able to carry the progress you make in the beta to the public version.

Xmas' Update is around the corner and the beta is here! First and foremost.

[b]Cass:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where players couldn't attack as Cass after using its Shuriken Skill.
[/list]

This issue should have been fixed. If not, please let us know as soon as possible.

[b]Xmas event and Quests:[/b]
 Find Presents that are scattered around the planets and decorate your Main Lobby menu by completing the quests.

[list]
[*]Added Christmas-themed decorations in the lobby menu.
[*]Added Christmas gifts in Contracts.
[*]Added "A Very Lethal Christmas!" Quest. Completing this quest will give rewards and decorate the Lobby menu.
[*]Added 12 Quests for Veteran Contracts.
[*]Added 12 Hero Quests.
[/list]

[b]Talismans:[/b]

Find and gather Talisman fragments to complete one. You can equip these forbidden objects of the Unseen to level it and up to unlock its full potential and remove its negative status.

[list]
[*]Added Talismans in the game. These objects are permanent unlockable items that can be equipped and leveled up. 
[*]Talismans fragments can be found in Colosseum Contracts or in Unseen chests in Contracts near Colosseum ones.
[*]Added 16 new Talismans.
[*]Added Colosseum Fragments.
[*]Added Contract Fragments.
[/list]

[b]UI: [/b]

[b]Hero:[/b]

[list]
[*]Updated Hero's selection screen.
[*]Updated the equipment and stats region to make it more compact.
[/list]

[b]Inventory:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Talisman tab in the Inventory. It appears once you find a Talisman.
[*]Added Talisman Equipment sections in the Inventory.
[*]Added quick switch between heroes in the Hero and Inventory screen, with the RMB, "Y" with the Xbox Controller and "△" with the DualShock Controller.
[*]Updated Skin's region to include Cosmetics.
[/list]

[b]Skills:[/b]

[list]
[*] Updated descriptions and icons on some Skills.
[/list]

[b]Cosmetics:[/b]
In this update, you will be able to add cosmetics in your Heroes. These are unlockable and permanent items.

[list]
[*] Character models have been prepared to be able to wear cosmetics.
[*] Added the first wave of Cosmetics, 36 in total. 4 of them being obtainable only during Christmas Quest events.
[*] Added body sections in the Skin section of Hero's selection screen: Head, Arms, Legs and Body.
[/list]
More cosmetics and Body part ones will come in future updates.

[b]Vanity Animations
[/b]
By holding the "C" key, or pressing twice the L3 joystick with the controller, players will be able to cast an emote inside Contracts.

[list]
[*]Added 4 Emotes on each Hero.
[*]More will be added in future updates.
[/list]

[b]Colosseum:[/b]

Vectors will no longer matter in this arena, only your skill.

[list]
[*] Removed Vectors in Colosseum Contracts. 
[*] In Recruit's Colosseum Contract, both enemies and players will have their Vector levels matched, regardless of its equipped items.
[*] In Spec Ops' Colosseum Contract, enemies will always be a step over you, with its Vector levels being slightly higher.
[*] Colosseum Contracts will always drop remaining Colosseum Fragments to complete a Talisman, but some will only appear in Recruit or Spec Ops.
[/list]

[b]General:[/b]

PSA: As discussed in our Player Survey, we have updated the least popular skill upgrades on each Hero. We encourage people to check and tryout their abilities.

[list]
[*]Added new animations on existing and new skill upgrades.
[*]Replaced Troy's "Focus" mechanic with "Luck of the Draw".
[*]Enemies will launch upwards in the air, instead of away from the player, with Kosmos' "Stomp" and Cass' "Dimensional Tear".
[*]Removed his buff damage passive every time he dodged. Instead, that extra damage is distributed to his other skill upgrades.
[*]Added Unseen Chests. These can give players Talisman fragments or Unseen Trinkets.
[*]Added Talisman EXP orbs. These can appear when you have a talisman equipped and level them up.
[*]Added Weather particle effects: Rain and Snow.
[*]Cass' Decay skill lasts 1 second longer.
[*]Added more translations in every supported language.
[*]Added Portuguese Community Translations. More to come in upcoming updates (Thanks a lot Mazter!).
[*]Added dmg buff % after a crit stat in Troy's "Cognita Finem", Cass' "King of Spades" and Zero's "Stinger".
[*]Removed the extra crit stat in Troy's "Cognita Finem", Cass' "King of Spades" and Zero's "Stinger".
[*]Fixed the issue where players would suddenly stop after skipping the dialogs by spamming the B or O button with the controllers.
[*]Fixed some emissive and vfx materials being too bright after Core Update's rendering changes.
[*]Fixed the bug where the upgrade "BETTER WEAPONS IN BLACK MARKET" could still appear in the gear "KORMOS-4994" (Thank you "Hissatsu").
[*]Fixed the bug where the "Upgrade Available F1" UI to show the text on its correct size in every supported language.
[*]Fixed the bug where the text at the rewards screen wouldn't appear on its correct size in every supported language.
[*]Fixed tutorial splash screens to appear on its correct size in every supported language.
[*]Updated localization files.
[/list]
[I will expand these patch notes in upcoming updates. Apologies for any inconveniences (Jmen).]

[h3]What are we doing right now:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Updating the texts of all the available languages (Thank you for your Portuguese reports Mazter!).
[*]Bug fixing.
[*]Sleeping a bit.
[*]If your game crashes, a Crash reporter will appear. Please add the details of what you were doing at the time of the crash and send it to us. If you want to, feel free to contact us directly here at killsquad@novarama.com, with your "Saved" folder (C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\Local\\Killsquad) attached.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Dev Diary: Cosmetic Shopping Spree!
notes.content:
Hello guys! 

It's Black Friday, and our heroes inside the Killsquad universe have gone in a shopping spree! Do you want to see all the new cosmetics, coming to you in our Christmas update? Look no further than the video below, straight from the dev team!

[previewyoutube=DgsNMGQITOk;full][/previewyoutube]

All these cosmetics will drop as part of our Christmas update mid-December. But there's more:

- Talismans, which bring passive permanent perks to our heroes
- A new Colosseum mechanic to earn these Talismans
- Better balancing of all the existing skills and perks. 
- A whole new soundtrack. Yes, the full game is getting new music.

Oh... and it's not only Black Friday for us, it's also Black Friday for you all! Go get Killquad 30% off, during our Steam Autumn event, from now til Monday.

notes.title: Killsquad Hotfix update 0.14.14.5
notes.content:
Halloween is over and Xmas is getting closer! This update brings ping display in crowded contracts. Players will be able to judge their network experience in multiplayer without the need of joining in blindly.

[h3]General[/h3]

[b]New Ping system[/b]
In the Contract selection screen, once you click a Contract with a player hosting / playing the game, the Ping will appear in the bottom right-corner of it.

[list]
[*] Added Ping to be displayed in the "Confirm Contract" selection screen. Ping numbers will be displayed in green, yellow and red as a recommendation for the multiplayer experience.
[*] Added Join priority between players hosting the same Contract. Clients will Join players with less lag and their pings will be displayed first. 
[/list]

[h3]Halloween Event[/h3]

[list]
[*] Reverted back the previous Lobby decorations now that the Halloween Event has ended.
[*] Restricted back Badges, Portraits, Halloween Skins and updated its descriptions.
[/list]

[h3]What are we doing right now[/h3]

[list]
[*] Updating the texts of all the available languages (Thank you again for your Portuguese reports Mazter!).
[*] Revisiting Cass' Shuriken bug.
[*] December's Update.
[*] If your game crashes, a Crash reporter will appear. Please add the details of what you were doing at the time of the crash and send it to us. If you want to, feel free to contact us directly here at killsquad@novarama.com, with your "Saved" folder (C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\Local\\Killsquad) attached.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Diary Update + Hotfix patch notes
notes.content:
Hello guys! 

Today's dev diary is rather short, as we are working on a number of things that will surface in the next few weeks. Let's go!

[b]Public vs. Private[/b]
As you will have noticed, private contracts are back, as we promised, just download the last update (from today) and you're good to go. We needed 2 weeks to do some R+D, that's done, so thank you for your patience. We'll be rolling out some changes based on this R+D, such as... 

[b]Ping![/b]
We are working on a Hotfix, which will drop next week, which adds ping counters to all contracts. Here's an image of how this will look like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/38f9bd5565674557ae8309753d34a6647e5c7fea.png[/img]

Here's a zoom, so you can see it better:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/d72544de7d738830a8ddc434d0c7aa9a69f007d2.png[/img]
So, before entering a contract, you'll know the quality of service you can expect, and only join if ping seems reasonable to you. These will be color coded (green/yellow/red) for easy scanning.

[b]Talisman work[/b]
Last, but not least, our Xmas update is coming up nicely. Here's some work on Talismans, first, the Talisman Chest, where you'll find Talisman fragments:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/2141a94b4734d02d695bee806c1e5819ccb35c87.png[/img]

And here are different UI elements of the Talismans, straight from the developer's hands:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/ce7880f4b56e129b7adf5bd24663440720dd3472.jpg[/img]

So again, a small update as a lot of work this week goes into internal systems. Next week we kick off our marketing campaign, so we will be way more active on social media. We hope to see you there!

As today we are also dropping a Hotfix with the Public vs. Private, please read below the full patch notes:

[h3]Killsquad Hotfix update 0.14.13.7[/h3]
This Hotfix update includes the return of the Host: Private option, more to come in the upcoming updates. We've gathered enough feedback and we want to thank you for your support.

General:

· Added back the ability of hosting private servers. Thank you for your feedback.
· Reworked the finding sessions to display more consistently players hosting public games.
· Reworked the ping displayed in-game to be more accurate with the ping between players and the Host of the game.
· Removed the loud sparks sounds in the Lobby menu.

What are we doing right now:

· Adding a Ping displayer in the Contract Selection Screen.
· Updating the texts of all the available languages (Thank you for your Portuguese reports Mazter!).
· Revisiting Cass' Shuriken bug.
· December's Update.
· If your game crashes, a Crash reporter will appear. Please add the details of what you were doing at the time of the crash and send it to us. If you want to, feel free to contact us directly here at killsquad@novarama.com, with your "Saved" folder (C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\Local\\Killsquad) attached.

notes.title: Dev Diary Update: Emotion everywhere
notes.content:
Hello guys! 

We at team Killsquad know you are sensitive people: always showing off your inner, soft core. Like when you smash the skull of an enemy. Or when you run towards victory totally ignoring our team mates, seeking MVP status. Killsquad is definitely a game for sensitive players! 

That's why on our Christmas update we're focusing on giving you more ways to express yourselves. 

Enter the new emote / animation system, dropping next month. Here's a quick internal video: you'll be able to press a button/key, and then select animations to show your state to your crew, or to celebrate. Check it out:

[previewyoutube=SsEor8zGvAE;full][/previewyoutube]

We are going to do functional animations (hello, come here, etc.) and also celebratory ones, so you can show off at mission end. Expect more of these soon, as the system is completed! Here's a pretty cool taunt animation for Kosmo. Romantic, isn't it?

[previewyoutube=aGVLD7rzmKo;full][/previewyoutube]

But we are working on other ways for you guys to feel powerful emotions. I want to highlight two. The first is the new weather patterns. Look at this beautiful rain: doesn't it make you want to hold hands, while we all walk towards sure destruction in the hands of the Abomination?

[previewyoutube=-X6Efhxd0gM;full][/previewyoutube]

And last, but not least, we have an announcement to make. If the animation system and the new weather effects didn't really touch your soul, this will: we are revamping the whole Killsquad soundtrack. Yep. All of it. We are now selecting pieces, but expect a much more varied soundtrack as you cross the Outer Reach. If you play the videos above, you may catch glimpses of it here and there. 

So, are you in a state of deep emotion? We thought so. And, if you're not, remember Killsquad is 30% off this weekend. So go grab a friend, and go crush some alien bones. 

Because destruction is so emotional.

notes.title: Dev Diary Update
notes.content:
Hello guys! What a recent two weeks we have had! Reviews are rising, sales are rising, we couldn’t be happier. So, first of all, THANK YOU guys for appreciating the effort we put in CORE. But we’re not here to talk about us: ego is the path to the dark side as the Master would say. Let’s talk about what comes next in Killsquad. Being an Early Access means you guys get an open window into our development process, so expect a design-heavy Dev Diary today. So, come on, grab your thinking hats! Here we go!

[h3]Public vs Private[/h3]
We have realized we have two communities in the game. Some of you want to meet new people to play with. Others prefer Solo/Private play. So, sometimes the game is actually very active, but there seems to be no-one to play with, as everyone is doing Private contracts. Both sides are right, and we’re trying to please both with a game that caters to both audiences. To better understand the issue, we put all contracts Public for a few days to understand what is going on under the hood.

As a result of our analysis, we are beginning to take action. First, we are working on a fix that will lower the overall lag in the game. It will also tell you from the contract map what the ping time will be on each contract, to ensure the best online experience. Giving you guys a good online experience is key to us, so we expect us to roll this out soon. But rest assured: private contracts will return. We appreciate your patience while we fix this.

[h3]Talismans[/h3]

One question we are asked a lot is: how will the new Talisman system work? What are passives gonna be like? Ok, here’s a deep-dive, thanks to Miki, the game’s Lead Designer:
[list]
[*] We want to give you better control on your hero’s build
[*] So, we want to give you items you can equip, that create passive mods that boost your hero in some way. Some may be stat boosts, some may be more creative stuff you will need to discover.
[*] These are the Talismans
[*] Talismans are ancient artifacts of power, owned by The Unseen.
[*] These Talismans have been shattered, and are now broken in pieces
[*] Talisman pieces can be found in some contracts, and also as a reward for beating the Colosseum: some Talismans on the recruit Colosseum, some on the Veteran
[*] So, to activate a Talisman, first you need to assemble it from its pieces
[*] Once the Talisman is assembled, you unlock its passive ability. This is vector-less, so Talismans don’t become old as you Vector up. So for example a Talisman can give you increased Dodge regen time regardless of what your Vector is
[*] On top of that, Talismans become better with use: the more you use them, the stronger they become, up to a cap in their power
[*] And you can equip two of them any given time, so better choose well which are your weaknesses to assess what do you need to boost. 
[/list]

As you can see, Talismans are a veteran / end game feature. They will begin appearing in late recruit, but we feel these are for pro players who really want to max out their heroes. Here's a first look at the Talisman UI:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/2f2ec61f179ac5f8eb75b0fb24c6b10f875d0815.jpg[/img]

Talismans will be deployed this Christmas, but will play a bigger role in our future updates, where we will unlock our endgame section (Inferno and Spec Ops where they will be much needed).

[h3]Cosmetics! Animations!
[/h3]
As you saw with Core, we are making sure we give you as many opportunities to customize your hero as we possibly can, within our design of “customize by equipment”: it’s the equipment what makes your hero different, not stats. 

Part of that is cosmetics, which we had way too little of: we had some skins, and that was about it. On the next update, this is going to change. You are going to get funky hats. Boots. Cool animations to celebrate victory (or defeat!). Today, we bring you a quick sampler of these. First, some cosmetic pieces of equipment:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/55149d719f1b0cba7e5513972e4e5313a1c638fc.jpg[/img]

And here is a cool Cass animation for you to trigger in game:

[previewyoutube=lc7lf4ndGqM;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Bienvenue a Killsquad! 我们很高兴您喜欢 Killsquad![/h3]

Yes, translations are here. If you download today’s build, there is support for:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Korean
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Italian
[*] Spanish
[*] Japanese
[*] English
[/list]
These are all human-made translations. But we know how this is a very sensible matter. So, as we did last time, we are publishing our [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mKunh7me0w2q8mPvhEcxNb50oRmTio9zsmXDDKYxauQ/edit#gid=659715333]localization file[/url]. 

If you find a mistake in your language and you want to reach out us, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]Discord server [/url]and go to the #bug-localization channel. We are aware of some issues, which we will fix next week with a Hotfix.

So that's it for today! What are you doing here still? Come on, go play!!!

notes.title: Killsquad’s new major update, CORE, launches today
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=tSGJ6TsbPWU;full][/previewyoutube]

After 7 months of hard work & feedback from the community, we are pleased to release CORE today, Killsquad's newest update. CORE brings deep changes to all internal game systems & redefines the Killsquad experience. Every piece of feedback we got, we took it on board. And vowed to fix all of them in a single, mega-update. CORE has been on Beta testing now for a few weeks, during which the recent review score of Killsquad on Steam has risen from 64 to well over 85. So, the wait is over. Welcome to CORE, we hope you like it.

[h3]New levelling up system
[/h3]
Before CORE, enemies levelled up: you levelled up, so did they. Bad idea: why keep playing, if enemies level up with you and the ratio stays the same? The full system is gone. Now, enemies have a static level. You don’t. So, level up to crush them mercilessly. And feel pleasure in doing so.

[h3]New enemies & enemy generations
[/h3]
If you out-level enemies, we need more of them. CORE brings many new enemies across all sections of the game. Plus, it brings Enemy Generations: we have created +30 new enemy variations: new behaviours, new color schemes, new attack patterns… so there’s much more to hunt and destroy.

[h3]Elemental resistance
[/h3]
Enemies, attacks and weapons now have elemental resistance. So you’ll need the right tool for the right monster. Don’t use a freeze gun on an ice monster, you fool! You can also equip gear that builds up resistance against certain types of damage. So if Helldörren is frying you, gear up to counter that.

[h3]Dual weapons
[/h3]
With elemental resistance, picking the right weapon is more important than ever. That’s why we give you dual weapons slots, with different damage profiles. Let’s call these the mob clearing and the boss buster weapon. Choose them wisely: both influence your level and your chances of survival.

[h3]Gadget system
[/h3]
In Killsquad, your character build comes from your gear. That’s why we introduce the Gadget system: consumable power-ups you can buy, carry with you and unbalance the battle. Life pools. Poison areas. Gadgets bring an unprecedented layer of customization, and mean life or death on harder missions.

[h3]Shop & reward system
[/h3]
Of course if we give you all this equipment, we need a place to go shopping, right? Enter the new shop! And also, pay attention to the contract end screens, these have all been revamped and now do a much better job at getting you excited about the new equipment you just earned.

[h3]New campaign map
[/h3]
This one is self-explanatory. Yes, a campaign map. A lovely one indeed, +20 contracts for you to unlock and master. Go check it out! And, while we are at it, new tutorials so all game systems are explained. 

[h3]Checkpoints
[/h3]
You have been crossing a perilous land for 45 minutes. Only to reach the final boss who, as bosses do, kills you in one strike. Back to the start! So unfair. We have fixed that. The game now automatically saves progress at key moments, so you can restart from there. More fun. Less frustration.

[h3]New rendering
[/h3]
We have replaced all the lighting code. Expect dark nights. Red sunsets. Rainy days. The kind of atmosphere that would feel extremely romantic, if it wasn’t because a ten ton monster is crushing your guts. So yeah, do kill the monster. But enjoy the views along the way.

[h3]Language support
[/h3]
Please be aware that CORE is temporarily only available in English and Spanish. A language pack including Italian, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Korean & Japanese support will be released next week as we confirm there are no bugs on the game.

[h3]Roadmap
[/h3]
CORE is just the beginning. Here is our Roadmap update. Christmas will bring cosmetics and Talismans. Q1 next year will take us on a journey to Skua, the base of the Feds. And summer next year we will unleash our endgame features and a fifth hero so the team building options expand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/d69b05f03c79d266effef0302b7733d4a135b6e6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/c6b20d34f63d8741b13bd9320e6f33f6262f916c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Bug reporting
[/h3]

Killsquad is an Early Access game. As such, it is a product in development. Have encountered a bug? We are sorry. Please report it by joining our Discord community. Please do so here:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]https://discord.com/invite/killsquad
[/url]

You can report bugs on the #beta-bug-report channel. Please be specific describing the bug: the easier for us to trigger the bug, the faster we solve it. If you don’t like Discord, do get in touch directly at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url] with the bug info.


[h3]We need your help!
[/h3]
Do you like our game? Would you like to help an independent developer? Here is what you can do:

[b]Reviews![/b]
Please write a review. This is THE single most important thing you can do. Reviews do magic to the Steam algorithm. Or, if you wrote a negative review back in the day, and feel we’ve done a good job, do you know you can update your review? Reviews are the blood that keeps us alive!

[b]Social media follow:
[/b]
Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]https://discord.com/invite/killsquad[/url]
Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/killsquadgame]https://twitter.com/killsquadgame[/url]
And on the Steam forums

[b]Streaming![/b]
Stream Killsquad, post videos on Youtube. Tell the world about it. If you have a significant following, contact us at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url], and we’ll try to support you in any way we can.

[b]Media[/b]
Are you a member of the media? We want to meet you! Contact us at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url]

[h3]About Killsquad[/h3]

Killsquad is an action-packed 4 player action RPG where sci-fi mercenaries raid planets seeking fame and glory. With three planets to explore, over twenty unique contracts to master, more than 100 weapons and 30 unique enemies, Killsquad offers an adrenaline-pumping journey into a dystopian future full of blood and black humour. Killsquad is now on Steam Early Access, with an approximate launch date of Summer 2021. 

[h3]About Novarama[/h3]

Killsquad is developed by Novarama, a Barcelona-based independent games developer with +18 years of experience, 11 of them as a Sony exclusive studio. With a team of +40 people, Novarama's mission statement is to building innovative games for mass audiences. Killsquad is our first fully self-published game. Visit Novarama's website at [url=www.novarama.com]www.novarama.com[/url]

notes.title: Dev Diary / Killsquad: CORE Beta 2 Available Now
notes.content:
Hello all!

Welcome to another Dev Diary! As you know, every Friday we bring you the latest on Killsquad's development to you, the community. Let's cut to the chase, shall we?

[h1]THANK YOU[/h1]

Since CORE dropped last Friday, Reviews on Steam have been super positive. All the feedback on Discord has been very encouraging. Our [url=https://discord.gg/rddgwum]Discord server[/url] is gaining new followers every day. We couldn't be happier. And the best is yet to come.

But today, let's talk about the Beta: we asked, and you responded. We received lots of bug reports, and we're clearing them quick. A big shout out to tehgreg, Bum, Petrisis, Mazter, shisaya24, leonardo_768, scotilen, griPP, zerogear, sikedjonny, MC, and everyone who reported issues on this beta update. Here is the report as of today:

[list]
[*]Fixed the bug where Zero's weapon, "Red Baron", could share its overcharged state when switching weapons.
[*]Fixed the bug where Troy's weapon, "Cognita Finem", dealt a 100% of Critical Hits (Thanks tehgreg).
[*]Fixed the bug where the game crashed when players used the Gadget "Ice Age Bomb" against Helldorren on its "Showtime" attack (Thanks tehgreg).
[*]Fixed the bug where the first encounter with the Runaway appeared with a higher Vector than intended.
[*]Fixed the bug where the first encounter with the Prototype Guerrilla appeared with a higher Vector than intended (Thanks lopedo).
[*]Fixed the bug where players would stop suddenly every time they pressed B with the controller to skip dialogs (Thanks Bum).
[*]Fixed the bug where after selecting "host private" in a contract, players returned to the Main Lobby without any selected contract (Thanks Bum).
[*]Fixed the bug where an exclamation mark appeared in Completed Quests (Thanks Petrisis).
[*]Fixed the bug where players couldn't unlock Spec Ops Contracts (Thanks Petrisis and tehgreg). 
[*]Fixed a localization bug in the description of "VectorUpCase 30" (Thanks tehgreg).
[*]Fixed the bug here players didn't earn Faction EXP in some situations (Thanks tehgreg).
[*]Fixed the bug where the Runaway's Codex entry couldn't be unlocked (Thanks tehgreg).
[*]Fixed long and missing texts in Quests (Thanks Bum and tehgreg).
[*]Fixed the small text that appeared in the "Move Right" Input Settings (Thanks tehgreg).
[*]And countless bugs found by our trusty internal QA team (Thanks Hannah, Arnau, Bing, Alba and all led by Jmen)
[/list]

We've fixed approximately 60% of the bugs reported by fans. At this pace, we'll be out of Beta soon. Now, to celebrate, we're happy to drop, effective now, Beta 2, which has all these bugs addressed. So it's a much better build. All the same rules of Beta 1 apply here, which I'll summarize below: 

[h3]FAQ[/h3]
[b]Joining the Beta[/b]
Follow this link [url=Killsquad Discord Channel]https://discord.com/invite/killsquad[/url] and enter the #beta-instructions channel.

[b]Save games[/b]
The Beta uses a branch of your save game. You’ll start beta with your existing save game, but the progress made during Beta won’t transfer to your main branch save game.

[b]Backing up your save game[/b]
Please do back up your main branch save game following these instructions:

Backup everything that it’s inside the “SaveGames Folder, which can be located here:

Users\\%Username%\\AppData\\Local\\Killsquad\\Saved\\SaveGames

Inside Steam’s “userdata” folder, you can find a couple of numbered ones. In here, you have to find Killsquad’s folder (910490) and backup these folders.

Program Files (x86)\\Steam\\userdata

And check out if you have this folder route. If you have it, back it up. If not, ignore. 

SteamLibrary\\steamapps\\common\\KillSquad\\Game\\Saved\\SaveGames

[b]Streaming the Beta[/b]
Please stream the beta! But please do not do it to showcase bugs or broken systems: we are constantly working on Killsquad and of course Betas *do* have bugs. 

[b]Reporting bugs[/b]
Report bugs in the #beta-bug-report of our Discord channel. Please be specific describing the bug: the easier for us to trigger the bug, the faster we solve it.

[h3]We need your help![/h3]

[b]Reviews![/b]
Haven’t written a review? This is THE single most important thing you can do! Please write one if you like our work!

[b]Social media follow:[/b]
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/killsquad
Twitter: @Killsquadgame
And on the Steam forums

[b]Streaming![/b]
Stream Killsquad! Tell the world about it, on Twitch, on Youtube, anywhere. If you have a significant following, contact us at killsquad@novarama.com, and we’ll try to support you in any way we can.

That's it for today. Come on, go play!
